LongCat-Flash Inference Performance Optimization on an Atlas A3 Cluster Overview This document primarily describes optimization methods for the LongCat-Flash model on Atlas A3 series products. Performance Optimization General Optimizations For parts of the LongCat-Flash architecture that are similar to Llama, refer to the general optimizations in Llama , such as fixing the KV Cache size, optimizing cos/sin, and fusing AddRMSNorm. Enable Graph Mode Using a static graph improves inference performance. LongCat-Flash uses the graph compilation process of the inference framework. It is triggered in ModelWorker.compilemodel in modelworker.py and calls compilemodelforward in graphutils.py to complete compilation. Configure the execution mode through modelconfig.exemode in the YAML file. The supported modes are eager, gegraph, and npugraphex. gegraph and npugraphex use the compiled model.forward in the Decode stage, while the Prefill stage runs in eager mode. Enable the Graph Compilation Cache torch.compile is a Just-In-Time compiler. Initial graph compilation usually takes a long time. In latency-sensitive model inference scenarios, enabling the graph compilation cache stores compiled static graphs and effectively reduces the latency of the first inference operation after service startup, improving inference performance. The current compilation entry is as follows: python self.modelcompiled = compilemodelforward( self.model.forward, exemode=self.exemode, enablecachecompile=self.enablecachecompile, cachedir=os.path.join(self.inferconfig.modelconfig.outputpath, "cachecompile"), enablestatickernel=self.enablestatickernel, ) Enable the graph compilation cache through the modelconfig.enablecachecompile switch in the YAML file. The cache directory is modelconfig.outputpath/cachecompile. gegraph mode uses torchair.inference.cachecompile, while npugraphex mode uses torch.npu.npugraphex.inference.cachecompile. npugraphex can also enable static kernel compilation through modelconfig.enablestatickernel. Multi-Stream Parallelism and Core Control In large-model inference scenarios, divide parallelizable scenarios into multiple streams for parallel computation. Computations on multiple streams overlap, reducing overall execution time. For details about multi-stream parallelism, see the official documentation (Chinese). In multi-stream scenarios, one stream may occupy all cores, reducing operator execution parallelism. Therefore, allocate cores to different streams to ensure the benefits of parallel operator execution. For details about core control, see the official documentation (Chinese). The original LongCat-Flash model paper provides a four-stage parallel strategy, shown in the following figure. We adjusted the parallel strategy. The following figure shows the adjusted multi-stream parallelism and core-control solution. Execute the second attention and FFN experts earlier and control the numbers of ai cores and vector cores on multiple streams so that the execution times of the two streams are close, with no significant tail, improving performance. stage1 does not use core control and occupies all ai cores and vector cores by default. In stage2, stream0 uses the c16v32 core-control solution, and stream1 uses c8v16. The current code controls this optimization through modelconfig.customparams.enablemultistreams: 0 disables it, 1 uses the preceding asymmetric core-control solution, and 2 uses the c12v24 solution for both stream0 and stream1. This optimization applies only to the Decode stage and does not support exemode: eager. See the following pseudocode for implementing multi-stream parallelism and core control. python attn layernorm with npustreamswitch(True, "1"): with limitcorenum(True, "8", "16"): router dispatch gmm combine with limitcorenum(True, "16", "32"): dense attn layernorm dense Weight Prefetch This optimization provides network weight prefetch. While operators compute, it uses idle bandwidth to move the weights of some memory-bound operators from HBM to L2 Cache in advance, improving operator performance. For details about npuprefetch, see the official documentation (Chinese). Enable npuprefetch through modelconfig.customparams.enableprefetch. In LongCat-Flash, this switch depends on the multi-stream optimization, so enablemultistreams > 0 must also be set. In the following example, Matmul weights are 20 MB. The preceding RmsNorm operator has a low memory-bandwidth requirement and executes for 10 us. Prefetch can write the Matmul weights to L2 Cache in advance. Ideally, the maximum prefetch size is HBMbandwidth / timeavailable. The actual prefetch size varies with the bandwidth used by the network and preceding operators. Assume that 10 MB can be prefetched and executes in parallel with RmsNorm. When the Matmul operator executes, it only needs to additionally read 10 MB of weights, substantially reducing memory-access time. Use profiling to determine whether the prefetch size and position are appropriate. If the performance of an operator running in parallel with prefetch degrades significantly, further adjust the prefetch position by starting prefetch earlier or moving it away from the degraded operator. If the position cannot be adjusted, reduce the prefetch size so that the parallel operator degrades as little as possible. To maximize prefetch benefits, adjust the configuration through comparative experiments. If the preceding operator is memory-intensive, such as Matmul, parallel execution is unsuitable because bandwidth contention may cause degradation. The general prefetch analysis and debugging process is as follows: mermaid %%{ init: { 'theme': 'neutral', 'fontFamily': 'Microsoft YaHei', 'fontSize':12 } }%% flowchart LR classDef start fill:#e6f7ff,stroke:#1890ff,stroke-width:1.5px classDef proc fill:#f6ffed,stroke:#52c41a classDef proc2 fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#ff7875 classDef judge fill:#fff7e6,stroke:#faad14 classDef procend fill:#f0f2f5,stroke:#8c8c8c S[Analyze profiling]:::start --> B{Is the preceding operator memory-intensive?}:::judge B -->Yes C[No prefetch opportunity]:::proc2 B -->No D[Theoretical prefetch size]:::proc D --> E{Does performance degrade?}:::judge E -->No F[Complete prefetch]:::procend E -->Yes G[Reduce the prefetch size or adjust the prefetch position]:::proc G --> E Note: Prefetch conditions may vary by model. Adjust the preceding process as needed. The following figure shows the prefetch positions in LongCat-Flash. We prefetch the corresponding weights for memory-bound operators such as QuantBatchMatmul (QBMM), MLAProlog, and Matmul. MLAProlog contains multiple matrix multiplications and has substantial data-movement overhead. Therefore, we prefetch the weights of the preceding QBMM to provide a larger prefetch window for MLAProlog and obtain greater performance benefits. To view the specific prefetch sizes and positions, search for the npuprefetch API in modelinglongcatflash.py and ffn.py . Enable SuperKernel When gegraph graph mode is enabled for Decode, SuperKernel optimizes the model computation graph within a user-defined scope. For details about SuperKernel, see the official documentation (Chinese). Enable SuperKernel through modelconfig.customparams.enablesuperkernel. It optimizes some operators within one SuperKernel scope to reduce task-scheduling wait time and scheduling overhead and improve overall performance. In LongCat-Flash, enablesuperkernel does not support eager or npugraphex mode. Because different streams use different core-partitioning strategies, calibrate each SuperKernel scope according to its core-partitioning and stream-partitioning ranges. The following figure shows the SuperKernel scopes calibrated for Longcat-Flash. MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) Low-Rank Compression Optimization In the Decode stage, use the low-rank compression method described in the DeepSeek paper to reduce KV Cache memory usage and improve inference efficiency. For the related implementation, see the forwardpageattentionabsorb function of the LongcatFlashAttention class. MLA uses Data Parallelism (DP) overall and separately partitions the oproj matmul with Tensor Parallelism (TP) to improve performance. Fused Operator Optimization MLA preprocessing performance optimization: Enable the [npumlaprologv3] fused kernel to replace computation before attention. It includes Q, K, and V linear-layer computation, rotary position encoding (ROPE), RmsNorm, and KV Cache update. Attention performance optimization: Enable the npufusedinferattentionscore (Chinese) fused kernel to accelerate MLA computation. oproj Tensor Parallelism K-Axis Partitioning Apply row partitioning to the oproj linear layer. The input dimension of oproj is numheads vheaddim, and the output dimension is hiddensize. During oproj TP, partition the input dimension by oprojtpsize. numheads vheaddim must be divisible by oprojtpsize, and each rank stores only the weights corresponding to some input channels. During inference, attnoutput first passes through alltoall, so each rank obtains only the input-feature section for which it is responsible. Each rank then applies the linear transformation to its local tensor to obtain a local output. Finally, reducescatter sums the local outputs of all ranks by element and partitions them along the batch dimension to obtain the output of each rank. Implement Expert Parallel (EP) and Enable Fused Operators for the MoE (Mixture of Experts) Module The MoE computation stage uses EP (Expert Parallelism), evenly distributing routed experts and zero-computation experts across cards. The current implementation is LongcatFlashMoE in modelinglongcatflash.py . In AFD scenarios, the independent FFN-side model is in ffn.py and is registered as longcatflashffn in the framework. Enable a Fused Operator for the Router Use the torchnpu.npumoegatingtopk (Chinese) operator to sort the router computation result and select the top-k experts. Prefill-Stage Optimization Routed experts in the Prefill stage use the Double-Routing strategy. For the specific computation steps, see the MoE deployment strategy optimization section in DeepSeek-R1 Prefill Inference Performance Optimization on an Atlas A3 Cluster . Decode-Stage Optimization High-performance expert computation: Use the torchnpu.npugroupedmatmul (Chinese) operator to process computation for multiple experts simultaneously, improving computation and data movement efficiency. High-performance multi-card communication routing: Enable the torchnpu.npumoedistributedispatchv2 (Chinese) and torchnpu.npumoedistributecombinev2 (Chinese) operators to implement multi-card communication under EP. Pass the copyexpertnum parameter to enable zero-expert processing in the dispatchv2 and combinev2 operators. The computation formula is MoE(orix) = orix. Before use, refer to the preceding operator documentation to check whether environment variables such as HCCLBUFFSIZE are configured appropriately and understand the operator scenarios and constraints. MLP Linear-Layer Optimization Merge MLP Linear-Layer Computation The original LongCatFlashMLP implementation contains three matmul operations: gateproj, upproj, and downproj. Merge gateproj and upproj into gateupproj to improve overall computation efficiency. MLP Linear-Layer TP Partitioning In MLP computation, gateupproj and downproj must be fully stored on every device, causing device memory pressure. This optimization partitions gateupproj along the N axis and downproj along the K axis across different devices in the densetp domain. This completes TP partitioning of the MLP linear layers, reduces per-device memory usage, and reduces weight movement overhead during matmul. Note that the MLP stage uses TP, while the surrounding Attention modules use DP. AllGather and ReduceScatter must run before and after MLP computation to perform DP -> TP -> DP conversion. Despite the additional communication overhead, this approach provides good overall performance benefits. In the current optimization practice, Dense FFN experts use TP8 partitioning. Support Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) MTP speculative inference is implemented. In scenarios that have not reached the computation bound, MTP provides good inference acceleration. Enable MTP through modelconfig.nextn in the YAML file. When nextn > 0, the framework loads LongcatFlashModelMTP, and mtpworker.py runs the speculative inference process. MTP1 and MTP2 are currently supported. Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) Optimization Optimization Motivation In non-disaggregated scenarios, the Attention and MoE modules are deployed on the same card. Because of the inherent characteristics of the ScMoE architecture, the Multi-Stream Parallelism and Core Control section designs a multi-stream strategy for Stage2 to achieve optimal performance. By allocating different numbers of cores, the Attention computation stream and MoE computation stream run as a parallel pipeline. However, after Stage2 uses core control, the two computation streams can use only some Cube and Vector cores, constraining operator compute power. Measurements on Atlas A3 show that without core control, MLAProlog/FA/MM/TBMM/QBMM take less time than with core control. The following table compares the execution times. Number of CubeVector Cores MLAProlog (μs) FA (μs) MM (μs) TBMM (μs) QBMM1 (μs) QBMM2 (μs) 12C24V 68.1 118 18 19.6 18.7 20.1 24C48V 45.2 91.8 14.2 12.5 14.6 16.3 Except for the number of cores, all preceding data was collected and decomposed from the full network under the same configuration. Based on the preceding analysis, Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) can be used for the LongCat-Flash-560B model to further reduce TPOT in the Decode stage. It separates the MoE module from the full network for independent deployment. In other words, the Attention and MoE modules are deployed on different nodes, and Send/Recv operators exchange data between nodes. Enable AFD through modelconfig.customparams.enableafd. The framework divides worldsize in half: Lower-half ranks load longcatflashffn, and upper-half ranks load the longcatflash main model. They exchange data between the Attention and FFN sides through dist.send/dist.recv. The following figure shows the network architectures before and after AFD is enabled. The following figure shows the independent deployment of Attention and MoE. Computation Flow Diagram After AFD is enabled, cross-node communication by Send/Recv uses SDMA and does not occupy Vector cores. When computation operators in the Attention module run in parallel with Send/Recv, they are no longer constrained by core control. In the computation flow shown in the following figure, the result of the first LayerNorm (LN) operator on the Attention node is sent to the FFN node through Send and simultaneously passed to the next operator for subsequent computation. After Send completes the send operation, Recv waits for and receives the data returned from the FFN node. Send/Recv on Stream1 of the Attention node overlaps with computation operators on the main Stream0, hiding communication behind computation. Similarly, the FFN node acts as the server. The first operator in its execution graph is Recv, which waits until the Attention node sends data through Send. After the FFN node receives the data, it performs Router/Dispatch/MoE-GMM/Combine and finally sends the data back to the Attention node through Send. FFN Weight Prefetch In non-disaggregated scenarios, after weights are prefetched for QuantBatchMatmul (QBMM), MLAProlog, and Matmul, the execution time of operators on Stream0 in Stage2 is similar to that of Router/Dispatch/MoE GMM/Combine on Stream1. In addition, no suitable time window exists for MoE GMM weight prefetch. Therefore, MoE GMM does not use weight prefetch. After AFD is enabled and core control is removed on the Attention side, MLAProlog/FA/MM/TBMM/QBMM take less time. The FFN side may become the computation bottleneck, causing Recv on the Attention side to wait a long time for data from the FFN side and producing a trailing EVENTWAIT gap in the computation flow, as shown in the following figure. To address the FFN-side computation bottleneck, prefetch the weights of memory-bound operators such as GMM/Matmul during communication gaps, reducing total FFN-side execution time, as shown in the following figure. In AFD scenarios, weight prefetch on the Attention side remains the same as in non-disaggregated scenarios. See Weight Prefetch . 基于Atlas A2/A3的Qwen Dense模型推理性能优化实践 概述 本文主要介绍Qwen2/Qwen3 Dense（非MoE）模型基于NPU的推理优化策略。基于Atlas A2/A3 训练/推理系列产品，实现BF16场景下的推理。 Tensor Parallel (TP)优化 Attention TP优化 切分策略 对Attention的张量切分策略可以分为对QKV头的切分和对线性层的切分。 在对QKV头切分时，attention的多头计算机制可以方便进行张量切分，每个头先独立计算，再将结果concat起来。假设模型的attention层需要对numheads个query按照切分数量attntpsize进行切分，要求numheads必须能被attntpsize整除，每张卡放置query头个数为numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize；key和value头数相等，且可能小于等于query头个数（在GQA场景下会小于）。为了确保每张卡至少放置一个key和value头，每张卡放置的key或value头数计算方法为 numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1)。 在对线性层oproj进行切分时，按照行切分即可。 计算分解 该优化策略先将Q、K、V的线性层计算合并为一次Matmul计算（mergedqkvproj），提升计算性能。将mergedqkvproj的输出结果按Q、K、V拆分后，对Q和K进行归一化操作（Qwen3启用QK-Norm，Qwen2无此步骤）并使用旋转位置编码，再计算attention，最后通过oproj层输出。 MLP TP优化 切分策略 对MLP层的gateproj与upproj进行列切分，对downproj进行行切分。同时对gateproj与upproj线性层采用合并计算的优化方式，得到gateupproj。 计算分解 MLP层存在gateproj、upproj与downproj三个matmul运算，具体运算为 x = down( SiLU(gate(x)) up(x) )。本优化将张量切分后的gateproj和upproj合并为gateupproj一次Matmul计算，将输出按中间维度切分为两块后，分别执行SiLU激活和element-wise乘法，最终通过downproj输出。 通过将gateproj与upproj合并计算，减少kernel launch次数，提升整体计算效率。 残差融合优化 在原始transformers实现中，每个DecoderLayer的残差连接和RMSNorm是分开执行的： residual = hiddenstates hiddenstates = RMSNorm(hiddenstates) hiddenstates = Attention(hiddenstates) hiddenstates = residual + hiddenstates ← 独立residual add 本优化通过使能 torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm 融合算子，将残差加法与RMSNorm合并为一次kernel调用： hiddenstates, residual = npuaddrmsnorm(residual, hiddenstates, weight, eps) 每层DecoderLayer包含两处残差连接（Attention前和MLP前），融合后每层减少两次独立的tensor加法算子及对应的显存读写开销。残差（residual）作为参数在层间传递，不再在每层内部做独立的add操作。 使能融合算子 RmsNorm算子优化 通过使能 torchnpu.npurmsnorm 算子，替代原始手动计算variance + rsqrt的实现，提升模型推理性能。 RoPE算子优化 通过使能 torchnpu.npuapplyrotaryposemb 融合算子，替代原始rotatehalf + 手动乘加的实现。同时对cos/sin进行预计算并缓存，避免每次forward动态计算。 FlashAttention融合算子优化 通过使能 torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2 推理场景下的FlashAttention融合算子，既可以支持全量计算场景，也可支持增量计算场景。 使能图模式 使用静态图可以获得更好的推理性能。通过覆写 modelrunner.py 中的ModelRunner的graphcompile函数，将模型编译为静态图。 W8A8 INT8 量化 Qwen3-8B 支持 W8A8 INT8 量化，其中权重采用 per-channel 静态量化，激活采用 per-token 动态量化。量化范围覆盖 Attention 的 mergedqkvproj / oproj 与 MLP 的 gateupproj / downproj，共 4 个 Linear 层。 启用量化后，MLP 计算切换至专用的融合算子路径：gateupproj 输出 int32 张量与 per-token scale，并作为 torchnpu.npudequantswigluquant 的输入，由该算子一次性完成反量化、SwiGLU 激活与再量化操作；输出的 int8 张量与对应 scale 由 downproj 直接接收并执行后续矩阵乘运算。该实现可使 gegraph 静态图模式下命中现有融合算子实现，避免因 AddRmsNormDynamicQuant 等组合算子尚未提供而触发的回退路径。 量化后的模型权重以 compressed-tensors 格式加载。量化相关代码逻辑由 mmquantmode 字段控制：仅当字段值为 w8a8int8 时启用 W8A8 量化路径，否则保持原 BF16 推理路径不变。 集合通信使能AIV展开 利用Device的Vector Core计算单元来加速通信操作的执行，可参考 HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE环境变量 ： shell export HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE=AIV 附录 环境部署以及样例执行

Qwen Dense Inference Performance Optimization on Atlas A2/A3 Overview This document primarily describes NPU inference optimization strategies for Qwen2/Qwen3 Dense (non-MoE) models. It implements BF16 inference on Atlas A2/A3 training/inference series products. Tensor Parallel (TP) Optimization Attention TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy The tensor partitioning strategy for Attention can be divided into QKV head partitioning and linear layer partitioning. When QKV heads are partitioned, the multi-head computation mechanism of attention makes tensor partitioning convenient. Each head is computed independently first, and the results are then concatenated. Assume that the attention layer of the model needs to partition numheads query heads by the partition count attntpsize. numheads must be divisible by attntpsize, and the number of query heads placed on each card is numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize. The numbers of key and value heads are equal and may be less than or equal to the number of query heads (they are smaller in GQA scenarios). To ensure that at least one key and one value head are placed on each card, calculate the number of key or value heads placed on each card as follows: numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1). For the oproj linear layer, use row partitioning. Computation Decomposition This optimization strategy first merges the Q, K, and V linear-layer computations into one Matmul computation (mergedqkvproj) to improve computation performance. After splitting the output of mergedqkvproj into Q, K, and V, normalize Q and K (Qwen3 enables QK-Norm, while Qwen2 does not perform this step), apply rotary position encoding, perform attention computation, and finally generate the output through the oproj layer. MLP TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy Apply column partitioning to gateproj and upproj of the MLP layer and row partitioning to downproj. Also merge the gateproj and upproj linear-layer computations into gateupproj. Computation Decomposition The MLP layer contains three matmul operations: gateproj, upproj, and downproj. The specific computation is x = down( SiLU(gate(x)) up(x) ). This optimization merges the tensor-partitioned gateproj and upproj into one gateupproj Matmul computation. It splits the output into two blocks along the intermediate dimension, performs SiLU activation and element-wise multiplication on them, and finally generates the output through downproj. Merging gateproj and upproj reduces the number of kernel launches and improves overall computation efficiency. Residual Fusion Optimization In the original transformers implementation, the residual connection and RMSNorm of each DecoderLayer run separately: residual = hiddenstates hiddenstates = RMSNorm(hiddenstates) hiddenstates = Attention(hiddenstates) hiddenstates = residual + hiddenstates ← independent residual add This optimization enables the torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm (Chinese) fused operator to merge residual addition and RMSNorm into one kernel call: hiddenstates, residual = npuaddrmsnorm(residual, hiddenstates, weight, eps) Each DecoderLayer contains two residual connections, before Attention and before MLP. After fusion, each layer eliminates two independent tensor addition operators and their memory read and write overhead. The residual is passed between layers as a parameter and is no longer independently added inside each layer. Enable Fused Operators RmsNorm Operator Optimization Enable the torchnpu.npurmsnorm (Chinese) operator to replace the original manually implemented variance + rsqrt computation and improve model inference performance. RoPE Operator Optimization Enable the torchnpu.npuapplyrotaryposemb (Chinese) fused operator to replace the original rotatehalf + manual multiplication and addition implementation. Also precompute and cache cos/sin to avoid dynamic computation in each forward operation. FlashAttention Fused Operator Optimization Enable the torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2 (Chinese) FlashAttention fused operator for inference scenarios, which supports both full computation and incremental computation. Enable Graph Mode Using a static graph improves inference performance. Override the graphcompile function of ModelRunner in modelrunner.py to compile the model into a static graph. W8A8 INT8 Quantization Qwen3-8B supports W8A8 INT8 quantization, with per-channel static quantization for weights and per-token dynamic quantization for activations. Quantization covers four Linear layers: Attention mergedqkvproj / oproj and MLP gateupproj / downproj. After quantization is enabled, MLP computation switches to a dedicated fused-operator path. gateupproj outputs an int32 tensor and per-token scale, which are passed to torchnpu.npudequantswigluquant (Chinese). The operator performs dequantization, SwiGLU activation, and requantization in one operation. The output int8 tensor and corresponding scale are directly received by downproj for subsequent matrix multiplication. This implementation enables the gegraph static graph mode to use an existing fused operator and avoids the fallback path caused by unavailable composite operators such as AddRmsNormDynamicQuant. Quantized model weights are loaded in compressed-tensors format. The mmquantmode field controls the quantization logic. The W8A8 quantization path is enabled only when the field value is w8a8int8; otherwise, the original BF16 inference path remains unchanged. Enable AIV Expansion for Collective Communication Use the device's Vector Cores to accelerate collective communication operations. For details, see the HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE environment variable (Chinese): shell export HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE=AIV Appendix Environment Deployment and Sample Execution (Chinese)

Qwen3.5-MoE模型推理性能优化实践 概述 本文主要介绍Qwen3.5-MoE模型基于NPU的推理优化策略。Qwen3.5-MoE模型同时包含full attention、linear attention和MoE结构，推理链路中既需要优化Attention与MLP类矩阵计算，也需要降低MoE路由、EP通信和归一化等小算子带来的开销。 本文按融合算子、TP/EP并行、图模式、计算逻辑和矩阵融合几个维度展开说明。 使能融合算子 RoPE融合算子优化 Qwen3.5-MoE的full attention层使用MRoPE位置编码。原始实现通常会通过切分、旋转、拼接等多个Tensor算子完成RoPE计算，算子数量较多，且会引入额外的数据搬运开销。 本样例在Qwen35MoeAttention中使用torchnpu.npurotarymul完成query和key的旋转位置编码计算。该算子即RoPE部分的核心融合算子。由于Qwen3.5-MoE只对head维度中的一部分应用RoPE，代码先将query/key拆分为旋转部分和透传部分，仅对旋转部分调用融合算子，最后再与透传部分拼接： python qrot = torchnpu.npurotarymul(qrot, cos4d, sin4d, rotarymode='half') krot = torchnpu.npurotarymul(krot, cos4d, sin4d, rotarymode='half') 该优化为通用优化，在Prefill和Decode阶段均可使用，用于减少RoPE计算中的小算子数量并提升位置编码计算效率。 FlashAttention融合算子优化 Qwen3.5-MoE的full attention层同时覆盖Prefill全量计算和Decode增量计算。若直接使用PyTorch原生attention实现，需要展开为QK矩阵乘、mask、softmax和PV矩阵乘等多个算子，显存访问和小算子调度开销较高。 本样例使用npufusedinferattentionscorev2作为推理场景下的FlashAttention融合算子。full attention层将Q/K/V组织为TND layout，并在写入block化KV cache后，通过blocktable、blocksize以及实际序列长度信息传入FA v2算子： python attnoutput, = faops.npufusedinferattentionscorev2( querystates, kcachefa, vcachefa, numqueryheads=self.numheadsperrank, numkeyvalueheads=self.numkeyvalueheadsperrank, softmaxscale=self.scalefa, inputlayout="TND", sparsemode=sparsemode, attenmask=forwardmetadata.attentionmask if isprefill else None, actualseqqlen=actualseqqlen, actualseqkvlen=actualseqkvlen, blocktable=blocktable, blocksize=self.blocksize, ) Prefill阶段通过sparsemode=3和attention mask表达因果掩码；Decode阶段先将当前token的K/V写入KV cache，再通过actualseqkvlen控制可见的cache范围。图模式Decode场景下，代码切换到torchair.ops.npufusedinferattentionscorev2路径，普通eager场景下使用torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2路径。 ChunkGDR融合算子优化 Qwen3.5-MoE的linear attention层使用Gated DeltaNet结构。Prefill阶段需要对整段序列进行chunk计算，原始PyTorch实现通过多次矩阵乘、decay mask构造、下三角求解等操作完成块内递推，涉及较多中间Tensor搬运和小算子调度。 本样例在Qwen35MoeGatedDeltaNet中使用torchnpu.npuchunkgateddeltarule作为Prefill阶段Gated DeltaNet的融合算子。启用条件为： 当前为Prefill阶段。 torchnpu支持npuchunkgateddeltarule接口。 融合路径中，算子接收TND格式的query、key、value输入，以及beta门控参数、initialstate递推状态、actualseqlengths序列长度信息和decay参数g，一次性完成chunk内的L2归一化、decay计算、下三角求解和递推状态更新： python coreattnout, lastrecurrentstate = torchnpu.npuchunkgateddeltarule( query.to(torch.bfloat16), key.to(torch.bfloat16), value.to(torch.bfloat16), beta=beta.to(torch.bfloat16), initialstate=initialstate, actualseqlengths=actualseqlens.to(torch.int32), scale=scale, g=g.to(torch.float32), ) 该融合算子将原始PyTorch实现中的以下操作合并： chunk decay的cumsum和指数计算。 块内注意力矩阵的下三角求解（替代逐行循环更新）。 块间递推状态更新和输出计算。 算子输出coreattnout和lastrecurrentstate，前者为当前chunk的attention输出，后者用于后续chunk计算或传递给Decode阶段。该优化主要用于Linear Attention Prefill场景，减少Gated DeltaNet块内递推计算中的小算子数量并提升计算效率。 RMSNorm融合算子优化 RMSNorm是Qwen3.5-MoE中高频出现的归一化操作，分布在attention前后、linear attention模块以及最终输出norm中。若使用PyTorch原生算子展开，通常包含平方、均值、rsqrt、乘权重等多个操作，推理时会带来较多小算子调度开销。 本样例在Qwen35MoeRMSNorm中使用torchnpu.npurmsnorm替换展开计算： python return torchnpu.npurmsnorm(x, self.normweight, self.eps)[0] 对于带残差输入的场景，样例使用torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm融合残差相加与RMSNorm计算： python y, , residual = torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm(residual, x, self.normweight, self.eps) 在Gated DeltaNet中，Qwen35MoeRMSNormGated同样使用torchnpu.npurmsnorm完成归一化，再与门控分支相乘。RMSNorm相关优化属于通用优化，在TP、EP以及不同batch配置下均可使用。 Matmul AllReduce融合优化 在TP并行场景下，部分线性层计算后需要执行allreduce汇聚各卡结果。常规实现会先执行Matmul，再单独执行集合通信。对于通信和计算开销都比较敏感的场景，可以使用torchnpu.npummallreducebase将矩阵乘与all reduce融合，以减少中间结果搬运和通信调度开销。 本样例封装了qwen35prefillmmallreduce，在满足条件时对需要TP汇聚的RowParallelLinear输出投影启用Matmul AllReduce融合，包括full attention的oproj、linear attention的outproj以及dense MLP的downproj： python return torchnpu.npummallreducebase(input, layer.weight.data, hcom, reduceop="sum") 该融合当前只在满足以下条件时启用： 开启enablemmallreducebase。 当前为Prefill阶段。 线性层TP切分数大于1，且输入已经按TP切分。 线性层无bias，且不使用skipbiasadd。 当前线性层为非量化计算路径。 能够获取对应通信组的HCCL group name。 该优化主要用于A3等支持该融合能力且通信收益明显的部署场景。若条件不满足，代码会回退到常规线性层计算，再按需执行dist.allreduce。 MoE Dispatch/Combine融合优化 Qwen3.5-MoE包含大量专家，Decode阶段每个token只激活部分专家。纯EP部署时，token需要按照专家归属在EP组内分发，专家计算完成后再按原token顺序聚合。如果使用普通alltoall配合多次重排、索引和combine操作，会产生较多通信和小算子开销。 本样例在纯EP Decode场景下提供torchnpu.npumoedistributedispatchv2与torchnpu.npumoedistributecombinev2融合路径。启用条件为： 开启enabledecodemoedispatchcombinev2。 当前为Decode阶段。 moeepsize > 1。 moetpsize == 1，即纯EP场景。 融合路径中，npumoedistributedispatchv2根据top-k专家选择结果完成token分发，并输出专家计算所需的辅助信息；专家计算完成后，npumoedistributecombinev2根据dispatch阶段生成的辅助信息完成跨EP聚合、权重加权和原序恢复： python output = torchnpu.npumoedistributedispatchv2(dispatchargs) ... return torchnpu.npumoedistributecombinev2(combineargs) 该优化减少了纯EP Decode链路中的手写重排、alltoall和finalize routing开销，更适合Decode阶段小batch、低时延场景。 TP和EP优化 Qwen3.5-MoE样例通过parallelconfig分别控制不同模块的并行策略。attntpsize控制full attention和linear attention的张量并行，moetpsize控制MoE专家内部矩阵的张量并行，moeepsize = worldsize // moetpsize用于控制专家并行规模。当前仅支持纯EP（moetpsize=1，moeepsize=worldsize）或纯TP（moetpsize=worldsize，moeepsize=1），混合EP+TP配置会在模型初始化时被拦截。Embedding、LM Head、dense MLP和oproj也分别提供独立TP配置，便于根据模型结构和卡数做更细粒度切分。 Attention TP优化 切分策略 Qwen3.5-MoE的full attention按照head维度进行TP切分。假设attention层的query头数为numheads，切分数量为attntpsize，则每张卡上的query头数为numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize；key/value头数为numkeyvalueheads，每张卡上的key/value头数为numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1)。每张卡只计算本rank负责的Q/K/V head，attention输出后再通过oproj和all reduce完成跨TP汇聚。 attentiontp Qwen3.5-MoE还包含linear attention层。该模块同样使用attntpsize切分linearnumkeyheads和linearnumvalueheads，每张卡计算本rank负责的Gated DeltaNet head。代码中会校验linearnumkeyheads和linearnumvalueheads必须能被attntpsize整除，避免切分后head分布不均。 计算分解 full attention层先通过mergedqkvproj一次Matmul完成Q、K、V投影，其中Q投影同时输出attention gate。随后将投影结果拆分为query、key、value，对query和key执行RMSNorm，再对RoPE维度调用npurotarymul完成位置编码。K/V写入block化KV cache后，Prefill和Decode阶段统一调用npufusedinferattentionscorev2完成attention计算；Decode阶段通过实际KV长度控制当前token可访问的cache范围。attention结果与gate相乘后进入oproj，最后通过all reduce或npummallreducebase完成TP汇聚。 attentioncalcu linear attention层的计算链路为inprojfused投影、depthwise conv、Gated DeltaNet核心计算、RMSNormGated以及outproj。其中Q/K/V/Z/B/A投影通过一次MergedColumnParallelLinear完成，并按attntpsize切分；Prefill阶段使用chunk Gated DeltaNet计算整段序列，Decode阶段使用npurecurrentgateddeltarule更新递推状态；outproj输出后同样执行TP汇聚。 MoE TP优化 切分策略 MoE TP用于切分单个专家内部的FFN矩阵计算。假设MoE层的切分数量为moetpsize，专家个数为numexperts，每个专家都按照MLP的TP方式切分：gateproj和upproj按列切分，downproj按行切分。同时，gateproj和upproj在权重加载后合并为w13weight，减少专家计算中的Matmul次数。 计算分解 每个专家层的原始计算为downproj(SiLU(gateproj(x)) upproj(x))。如下图所示，本样例将gateproj和upproj合并为一次GroupedMatmul计算，输出结果通过npuswiglu完成SiLU(gate) up，再通过第二次GroupedMatmul完成downproj计算。专家输出经过npumoefinalizerouting恢复token顺序并按路由权重聚合；当moetpsize > 1时，最后通过moetpgroup执行all reduce汇聚各TP分片结果。 moetp 该方式适合专家权重较大、需要降低单卡显存占用的场景；当moetpsize == worldsize时，moeepsize为1，所有专家在TP组内切分计算，不发生EP维度的专家分发。 MoE EP优化 MoE EP用于将路由专家均匀分布到不同rank上。代码中每张卡只加载本rank负责的专家范围： python expertsperrank = numexperts // moeepsize localexpertstart = moeeprank expertsperrank localexpertend = localexpertstart + expertsperrank 普通EP路径采用Double-Routing方式完成token分发、专家计算和结果恢复。该流程如下图所示，图中编号与下方步骤一一对应。 moeep 主要计算步骤如下： 1. 调用npumoeinitroutingv2，对本rank上的token按照top-k专家进行展开和排序，得到expandedx，同时获取每个专家需要计算的token数量tokensperexpert以及用于恢复原始token顺序的expandedrowidx。 2. 对tokensperexpert执行EP组内AlltoAll，计算当前rank需要发送给其他rank的inputsplits，以及当前rank需要从其他rank接收的outputsplits。 3. 调用dist.alltoallsingle，按照inputsplits和outputsplits在moeepgroup内分发token，使每张卡获取本地专家需要处理的token。 4. 调用npumoererouting，对接收到的token按照本地专家重新排序，得到hiddenstatesorderedbyexperts、tokensperlocalexpert以及用于恢复本地接收顺序的gatheredidsunsort。 5. 调用专家计算模块，使用GroupedMatmul完成本rank本地专家的FFN计算。 6. 使用torch.indexselect按照gatheredidsunsort恢复本地接收token顺序。 7. 再次调用dist.alltoallsingle，将专家计算结果从本地专家rank发送回原始token所在rank。 8. 调用npumoefinalizerouting，根据第1步保存的expandedrowidx恢复token原始顺序，并按照router权重聚合top-k专家输出。 在纯EP Decode场景，即moeepsize > 1且moetpsize == 1时，普通Double-Routing链路还可以替换为npumoedistributedispatchv2和npumoedistributecombinev2融合路径，进一步减少Decode阶段通信路由开销。 图模式 Qwen3.5-MoE在Decode阶段以单token增量推理为主，算子粒度较小，在NPU上容易出现Host-bound问题。为减少CPU到NPU的逐算子下发与同步开销，样例结合torchnpu的TorchAir图模式编译能力，将Decode阶段尽可能编译为整图执行，从而降低调度开销并提升低时延推理性能。（当前图模式仅支持TP并行配置） 针对图模式的核心处理是：Prefill阶段仍使用普通model.forward完成整段输入计算和状态初始化；Decode阶段进入单token生成后，如果exemode为gegraph (npugraphex模式暂未验证)，则调用编译后的modelcompiled执行。 python if self.exemode in ["gegraph", "npugraphex"] and not isprefill: logits = self.modelcompiled(modelinputs) else: logits = self.model(modelinputs) 图编译在warm-up阶段触发。执行器先运行一次Prefill初始化KV cache和linear attention状态，再使用单token输入触发Decode图编译，保证正式推理时可以直接使用已编译的Decode图。 python if self.exemode in ["gegraph", "npugraphex"]: self.mainworker.compilemodel() 对于固定配置反复启动的推理任务，可以通过enablecachecompile开启图编译缓存，减少后续启动时的编译等待时间。 矩阵融合优化 Gated DeltaNet输入投影融合 Qwen3.5-MoE的linear attention层包含Gated DeltaNet结构。原始实现中，inprojqkv、inprojz、inprojb和inproja是多次独立线性层计算： python mixedqkv = self.inprojqkv(hiddenstates) z = self.inprojz(hiddenstates) b = self.inprojb(hiddenstates) a = self.inproja(hiddenstates) 当前样例将上述输入投影合并为inprojfused，通过一次MergedColumnParallelLinear同时计算Q/K/V分支、Z门控分支以及B/A分支，再按输出维度拆分： python fusedproj = self.inprojfused(hiddenstates) mixedqkv, z, b, a = torch.split( fusedproj, [self.keydim 2 + self.valuedim, self.valuedim, self.numvheads, self.numvheads], dim=-1, ) 该优化减少了Gated DeltaNet输入侧的Matmul次数，也让mixedqkv、z、b和a走同一套TP切分、量化和输出dtype路径，避免多路独立投影在量化或并行切分场景下出现dtype不一致。随后mixedqkv进入depthwise conv和Gated DeltaNet核心计算，z作为RMSNormGated的门控输入参与输出归一化，b和a用于生成Gated DeltaNet中的递推参数。

Qwen3.5-MoE Inference Performance Optimization Practices Overview This document describes NPU-based inference optimizations for Qwen3.5-MoE. The model combines full attention, linear attention, and MoE structures. The inference path therefore needs to optimize Attention and MLP matrix operations while reducing the overhead of MoE routing, EP communication, normalization, and other small operators. The practices are organized around fused operators, TP/EP parallelism, graph mode, computation decomposition, and matrix fusion. Fused Operator Enablement Fused RoPE Operator The full attention layers use MRoPE positional encoding. A native implementation usually splits, rotates, and concatenates tensors through multiple operators, causing extra data movement and scheduling overhead. This sample uses torchnpu.npurotarymul in Qwen35MoeAttention to rotate query and key. Because RoPE is applied to only part of the head dimension, the code splits query/key into rotated and pass-through parts, applies the fused operator to the rotated parts, and concatenates them: python qrot = torchnpu.npurotarymul(qrot, cos4d, sin4d, rotarymode='half') krot = torchnpu.npurotarymul(krot, cos4d, sin4d, rotarymode='half') This optimization applies to both Prefill and Decode and reduces the number of small operators in positional encoding. Fused FlashAttention Operator The full attention layers support both full-sequence Prefill and incremental Decode. Expanding native PyTorch attention into QK matmul, mask, softmax, and PV matmul causes considerable memory access and scheduling overhead. The sample uses npufusedinferattentionscorev2 as the FlashAttention operator for inference. Q/K/V use the TND layout. After writing block-based KV cache, blocktable, blocksize, and actual sequence lengths are passed to FA v2: python attnoutput, = faops.npufusedinferattentionscorev2( querystates, kcachefa, vcachefa, numqueryheads=self.numheadsperrank, numkeyvalueheads=self.numkeyvalueheadsperrank, softmaxscale=self.scalefa, inputlayout="TND", sparsemode=sparsemode, attenmask=forwardmetadata.attentionmask if isprefill else None, actualseqqlen=actualseqqlen, actualseqkvlen=actualseqkvlen, blocktable=blocktable, blocksize=self.blocksize, ) In Prefill, causal masking is represented by sparsemode=3 and the attention mask. In Decode, K/V are written to the KV cache first and actualseqkvlen limits the visible cache range. Graph-mode Decode uses torchair.ops.npufusedinferattentionscorev2; eager execution uses torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2. Fused Chunk Gated DeltaNet Operator The linear attention layers use Gated DeltaNet. Prefill computes a complete sequence in chunks. The native PyTorch implementation performs multiple matrix multiplications, decay-mask construction, and triangular solves, creating many intermediate tensors. In Qwen35MoeGatedDeltaNet, the sample uses torchnpu.npuchunkgateddeltarule for Prefill when the current phase is Prefill and the interface is available: python coreattnout, lastrecurrentstate = torchnpu.npuchunkgateddeltarule( query.to(torch.bfloat16), key.to(torch.bfloat16), value.to(torch.bfloat16), beta=beta.to(torch.bfloat16), initialstate=initialstate, actualseqlengths=actualseqlens.to(torch.int32), scale=scale, g=g.to(torch.float32), ) The fused operator combines chunk-decay cumulative sum and exponentiation, the in-chunk lower-triangular solve, and inter-chunk recurrent-state update and output computation. coreattnout is the current chunk output, while lastrecurrentstate is passed to subsequent chunks or Decode. This primarily benefits Linear Attention Prefill. Fused RMSNorm Operator RMSNorm is frequently used before and after attention, in linear attention, and in the final output norm. Expanding it into square, mean, reciprocal square root, and weighted multiply operations creates scheduling overhead. Qwen35MoeRMSNorm uses torchnpu.npurmsnorm: python return torchnpu.npurmsnorm(x, self.normweight, self.eps)[0] For residual inputs, the sample fuses residual addition and RMSNorm with torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm: python y, , residual = torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm(residual, x, self.normweight, self.eps) Qwen35MoeRMSNormGated uses the same RMSNorm operator before multiplying by the gate. These optimizations apply across TP, EP, and different batch sizes. Fused Matmul AllReduce In TP execution, some linear layers must all-reduce results across cards. Instead of launching Matmul and collective communication separately, torchnpu.npummallreducebase fuses them and reduces intermediate data movement and scheduling overhead. The sample wraps this operation in qwen35prefillmmallreduce for RowParallelLinear output projections, including full-attention oproj, linear-attention outproj, and dense-MLP downproj: python return torchnpu.npummallreducebase(input, layer.weight.data, hcom, reduceop="sum") Fusion is enabled only when enablemmallreducebase is enabled, the phase is Prefill, TP size is greater than one and the input is TP-sharded, the layer has no bias and does not use skipbiasadd, the layer is non-quantized, and the HCCL group name is available. It is mainly intended for deployments such as A3 where this capability provides communication gains. Otherwise, execution falls back to the normal linear layer and, when needed, dist.allreduce. Fused MoE Dispatch/Combine Qwen3.5-MoE contains many experts, while each Decode token activates only a subset. In pure EP deployment, tokens must be dispatched by expert ownership and then combined in their original order. A conventional alltoall path with repeated reordering, indexing, and combine operations adds communication and small-operator overhead. For pure EP Decode, the sample provides fused torchnpu.npumoedistributedispatchv2 and torchnpu.npumoedistributecombinev2. The path requires enabledecodemoedispatchcombinev2, Decode phase, moeepsize > 1, and moetpsize == 1. python output = torchnpu.npumoedistributedispatchv2(dispatchargs) ... return torchnpu.npumoedistributecombinev2(combineargs) The dispatch operator distributes tokens and emits auxiliary expert information; combine uses that information for cross-EP aggregation, weighted combination, and original-order restoration. This is suited to small-batch, low-latency Decode. TP and EP Optimization The sample controls module parallelism through parallelconfig. attntpsize controls tensor parallelism for full and linear attention, moetpsize controls tensor parallelism inside each MoE expert, and moeepsize = worldsize // moetpsize controls expert parallelism. Only pure EP (moetpsize=1, moeepsize=worldsize) or pure TP (moetpsize=worldsize, moeepsize=1) is supported; mixed EP+TP is rejected during model initialization. Embedding, LM Head, dense MLP, and oproj also have independent TP settings. Attention TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy Full attention is partitioned by head. Given numheads query heads and attntpsize, each card receives numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize; key/value heads use numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1). Each card computes its local Q/K/V heads, then oproj and all-reduce aggregate TP results. attentiontp Linear attention likewise partitions linearnumkeyheads and linearnumvalueheads by attntpsize. The implementation checks that both counts are divisible by attntpsize so head distribution remains balanced. Computation Decomposition Full attention computes Q/K/V in one mergedqkvproj Matmul; the Q projection also emits the attention gate. The result is split into query, key, and value, query/key receive RMSNorm, and npurotarymul applies RoPE. After K/V are written to block KV cache, both Prefill and Decode call npufusedinferattentionscorev2; Decode uses the actual KV length to limit cache visibility. The attention result is multiplied by the gate and passed to oproj, followed by all-reduce or npummallreducebase. attentioncalcu The linear-attention path consists of inprojfused, depthwise convolution, Gated DeltaNet, RMSNormGated, and outproj. Q/K/V/Z/B/A are produced by one MergedColumnParallelLinear and partitioned by attntpsize; Prefill uses chunk Gated DeltaNet and Decode updates recurrent state with npurecurrentgateddeltarule. TP aggregation follows outproj. MoE TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy MoE TP partitions the FFN matrices inside each expert. With moetpsize partitions and numexperts experts, gateproj and upproj are column-partitioned, while downproj is row-partitioned. After loading, gateproj and upproj are merged into w13weight to reduce Matmul operations. Computation Decomposition Each expert computes downproj(SiLU(gateproj(x)) upproj(x)). The sample merges gateproj and upproj into one GroupedMatmul, applies npuswiglu for SiLU(gate) up, and uses a second GroupedMatmul for downproj. npumoefinalizerouting restores token order and combines router-weighted outputs; when moetpsize > 1, moetpgroup all-reduces TP shards. moetp This approach suits large expert weights where per-card memory must be reduced. When moetpsize == worldsize, moeepsize is 1 and experts are partitioned within the TP group without EP dispatch. MoE EP Optimization MoE EP distributes routed experts across ranks. Each card loads only its local expert range: python expertsperrank = numexperts // moeepsize localexpertstart = moeeprank expertsperrank localexpertend = localexpertstart + expertsperrank The normal EP path uses Double Routing for dispatch, expert computation, and restoration. moeep 1. Call npumoeinitroutingv2 to expand and sort local tokens by top-k experts, producing expandedx, tokensperexpert, and expandedrowidx. 2. AlltoAll tokensperexpert within the EP group to determine inputsplits and outputsplits. 3. Call dist.alltoallsingle with those splits so each card receives tokens for its local experts. 4. Call npumoererouting to sort received tokens by local expert and produce hiddenstatesorderedbyexperts, tokensperlocalexpert, and gatheredidsunsort. 5. Run local expert FFNs with GroupedMatmul. 6. Use torch.indexselect with gatheredidsunsort to restore local receive order. 7. Call dist.alltoallsingle again to return expert results to the original token ranks. 8. Call npumoefinalizerouting with expandedrowidx to restore original token order and combine top-k outputs using router weights. In pure EP Decode (moeepsize > 1 and moetpsize == 1), the Double-Routing path can be replaced by npumoedistributedispatchv2 and npumoedistributecombinev2 to further reduce communication overhead. Graph Mode Decode is dominated by single-token incremental inference. Its small operators can make NPU execution host-bound. The sample uses torchnpu TorchAir graph compilation to compile Decode into a whole graph, reducing CPU-to-NPU dispatch and synchronization overhead. Graph mode currently supports only TP configurations. During Prefill, normal model.forward computes the full input and initializes state. Once Decode starts, gegraph (the npugraphex mode is not yet verified) executes the compiled model: python if self.exemode in ["gegraph", "npugraphex"] and not isprefill: logits = self.modelcompiled(modelinputs) else: logits = self.model(modelinputs) Compilation is triggered during warm-up. The executor first runs Prefill to initialize KV cache and linear-attention state, then uses a single-token input to compile the Decode graph. For repeated runs with fixed settings, enablecachecompile enables graph compilation caching and avoids subsequent compilation waits. Matrix Fusion Optimization Gated DeltaNet Input Projection Fusion The linear-attention layers contain Gated DeltaNet. The original implementation computes inprojqkv, inprojz, inprojb, and inproja as independent linear layers: python mixedqkv = self.inprojqkv(hiddenstates) z = self.inprojz(hiddenstates) b = self.inprojb(hiddenstates) a = self.inproja(hiddenstates) The sample merges these projections into inprojfused, using one MergedColumnParallelLinear for Q/K/V, the Z gate, and B/A, then splits by output dimension: python fusedproj = self.inprojfused(hiddenstates) mixedqkv, z, b, a = torch.split( fusedproj, [self.keydim 2 + self.valuedim, self.valuedim, self.numvheads, self.numvheads], dim=-1, ) This reduces input-side Matmul operations and gives mixedqkv, z, b, and a the same TP partitioning, quantization, and output-dtype path. mixedqkv then enters depthwise convolution and Gated DeltaNet; z gates RMSNormGated output normalization, while b and a generate recurrent parameters.

基于Atlas A3、950训练/推理集群的Qwen3-MoE模型低时延推理性能优化实践 概述 本文主要介绍Qwen3-MoE模型基于NPU的低时延推理优化策略。 基于Atlas A3 训练/推理系列产品，decode采用8卡部署，实现BF16场景下单batch推理时延小于20ms。 基于Atlas 950 PR 训练/推理系列产品，decode采用4卡部署，实现W4A8混精推理4K场景下单batch Prefill时延小于280ms,Decode时延小于24ms。 低时延场景Tensor Parallel (TP)优化 Attention TP优化 切分策略 对Attention的张量切分策略可以分为对QKV头的切分和对线性层的切分。 在对QKV头切分时，attention的多头计算机制可以方便进行张量切分，每个头先独立计算，再将结果concat起来。假设模型的attention层需要对numheads个query按照切分数量attntpsize进行切分，要求numheads必须能被attntpsize整除，每张卡放置query头个数为numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize；key和value头数相等，且可能小于等于query头个数（在MQA和GQA的场景下会小于）。为了确保每张卡至少放置一个key和value头，每张卡放置的key或value头数计算方法为 numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1)。QKV头在多卡上的排布情况如下图所示。 attentiontp 在对线性层oproj进行切分时，按照行切分即可。 计算分解 该优化策略先将Q、K、V的线性层计算合并为一次Matmul计算（图中mergedqkvproj），提升计算性能。将mergedqkvproj的输出结果按Q、K、V拆分后，对Q和K进行归一化操作并使用旋转位置编码，再计算attention（图中Fusedinferattentionscore），最后通过oproj层输出。 attentioncalcu MoE TP优化 切分策略 假设模型的MoE层的切分数量为moetpsize，专家个数为expertnum。对MoE层进行张量切分，每个专家相当于一个mlp层，切分方法与mlp的张量切分方法相似。具体做法是对gateproj与upproj进行列切分，对downproj进行行切分。同时对gateproj与upproj线性层采用合并计算的优化方式，得到w13weight。 计算分解 每个专家层存在gateproj、upproj与downproj三个matmul运算，具体运算为 x = down( SiLU(gate(x))up(x) )。本优化将张量切分后的gateproj和upproj进行concat操作，再使能 torchnpu.npuswiglu 融合算子接口优化，该算子能完成以下两步计算： 将输入的x沿最后一维切分为两块，即x = torch.chunk(x, 2, -1)。 计算并返回 SiLU(x[0]) x[1]。 本优化通过将gateproj与upproj合并计算，提升整体计算效率。 moecalcu 使能融合算子 GMM使能和Routing优化 在MoE模块中，如果通过for循环处理每个专家，单独计算expertnum个前馈神经网络（FFN），容易导致计算效率较低。CANN提供了GroupedMatmul算子，可以同时计算多个专家，从而提高计算和搬运效率。具体实现可参考在 Qwen3MoeSparseMoeBlock 类中的 moeinfertp 和moeinferfusion函数。 快速选择专家：在计算专家和token之间的路由分数时，可以使用 torchnpu.npumoegatingtopksoftmax 融合算子，代替原来先topk再softmax多算子操作，可以更快速地计算出token和专家的分数。 高效排序和token路由： 使能 torchnpu.npumoeinitrouting 融合算子，实现MoE routing计算，获取专家的排序； 使能 torchnpu.npumoecomputeexperttokens 融合算子，获取每个专家需要计算的token数； 使能 torchnpu.npumoefinalizerouting 融合算子，将专家计算完成后的token重新排布并加权求和，获得最终输出。 高性能专家计算：使能 torchnpu.npugroupedmatmul 融合算子，实现多个专家的矩阵乘计算，提高计算和搬运效率。 RmsNorm算子优化 通过使能 torchnpu.npurmsnorm 算子，能够提升模型的推理性能。RmsNorm是大模型常用的归一化操作，相比LayerNorm，其去掉了减去均值的部分。 flash attention融合算子优化 通过使能 torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscore 推理场景下支持图模式的FlashAttention算子，既可以支持全量计算场景，也可支持增量计算场景。 使能图模式 使用静态图可以获得更好的推理性能。Qwen3MoeRunner通过覆写 modelrunner.py 中的ModelRunner的graphcompile函数，将模型编译为静态图。 使能图编译缓存 在模型推理场景下，使能图编译缓存可以缓存编译后的静态图，避免每次推理都需要编译模型，从而提高推理性能。可参考Qwen3MoeRunner中graphcompile函数中的使用： python if self.enablecachecompile: casename = "compilecache/" + os.getenv("CASENAME") cachedir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(file)), casename) self.model.decode = tng.inference.cachecompile(self.model.decode, cachedir=cachedir, config=compilerconfig, dynamic=True, fullgraph=True, gecache=True) 缓存默认路径为./compilecache/CASENAME。 集合通信使能AIV展开 利用Device的Vector Core计算单元来加速通信操作的执行，可参考 HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE环境变量 ： shell export HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE=AIV 高吞吐场景Prefill优化（Attention SP+TP, MoE EP） 概述 在Prefill推理场景下，模型需要一次性处理完整的输入序列，计算密集度高。为在TTFT时延约束下实现最大吞吐，采用Attention序列并行（SP）+张量并行（TP）与MoE专家并行（EP）的组合策略，结合MXFP8/MXFP4量化与多算子融合，显著降低Prefill阶段的计算与通信开销。 Attention SP+TP优化 并行策略选择 Prefill阶段算子多为计算bound，TP并行在切分后每卡的序列长度缩短，但AllReduce通信量与完整序列成正比。SP并行沿序列维度切分，每卡仅处理seqlen // attntpsize长度的子序列，通信算子采用AlltoAll，通信数据量更小且可配合低bit量化。 综合考虑通信数据量、数据类型和额外引入算子三个因素，Prefill阶段Attention采用SP+TP混合并行： FA前通信：使用AllGather将各Rank的子序列聚合成完整序列，配合MXFP8量化减小通信体积； FA后通信：使用AlltoAll将oproj的输出按序列维度重新分发到各Rank，配合MXFP8量化。 切分策略 输入序列沿token维度按attntpsize均分，每个Rank处理seqlen // attntpsize个token。要求输入序列长度能被attntpsize整除，不足时进行padding对齐。 Rank 0: [token0, ..., token{S/P-1}] Rank 1: [token{S/P}, ..., token{2S/P-1}] ... Rank P-1: [token{(P-1)S/P}, ..., token{S-1}] 其中S为序列长度，P为attntpsize。 计算分解 Prefill阶段的Attention计算流程如下： 1. 序列切分与Embedding：输入inputids按attntpsize切分，每个Rank仅对自身持有的子序列做Embedding； 2. AllGather聚合：通过dist.allgatherintotensor将各Rank的hiddenstates聚合为完整序列，若使能MXFP8量化则同时聚合hiddenstatesscale； 3. mergedqkvproj：对聚合后的完整序列执行QKV线性层计算； 4. FlashAttention：使用npufusedinferattentionscorev2完成注意力计算； 5. oproj + AlltoAll：oproj使用ReplicatedLinear（每卡持有完整权重），输出经MXFP8量化后通过AlltoAll按序列维度重新分发，每个Rank仅保留自身负责的子序列部分； 6. MoE输入准备：AlltoAll后的输出shape为(seqlen // attntpsize, hiddensize)，直接作为MoE层的输入。 attentionsptpprefill MoE EP优化 并行策略选择 MoE部分支持TP和EP两种并行方式。TP并行会将GMM的K或N轴切得过小，导致计算性能下降。EP并行每个Rank持有部分专家，通过通信完成token与专家的路由匹配，在eprank数较小时通信开销可控。 EP并行进一步分为AllGather方案和Double Routing（AlltoAll）方案： 并行策略 通信算子 通信数据量 适用场景 ------------ EP (AllGather) AllGather + ReduceScatter (B,S,H) × 2 eprank较小、topk > eprank时数据量更小 EP (Double Routing) AlltoAll + AlltoAll (BS×topk/eprank, H) × 2 大EP场景、eprank > topk时数据量更小 当前Qwen3-MoE模型topk=8，在eprank=4时topk > eprank，AllGather方案通信数据量更小，为默认优选方案。 计算分解（AllGather方案，W4A8量化） 当使能W4A8（MXFP4）量化且attntpsize == moeepsize时，MoE EP采用AllGather + ReduceScatter通信模式，具体流程如下： 1. MXFP8量化：对输入hiddenstates执行npudynamicmxquant，得到MXFP8量化数据及scale； 2. AllGather：通过dist.allgatherintotensor聚合各Rank的量化数据、scale、topkids和topkweight，得到完整序列的token信息； 3. Routing：使用npumoeinitroutingv2对聚合后的token进行专家路由，仅筛选属于本Rank的专家范围内的token； 4. GMM计算：通过npugroupedmatmul（封装在 FusedMoEGMM 中）完成多专家并行矩阵乘计算； 5. Finalize Routing：使用npumoefinalizerouting将专家计算结果按路由信息重新排布并加权求和； 6. ReduceScatter：通过dist.reducescattertensor将各Rank的部分结果归约并分发，每个Rank获得自身负责的子序列输出。 计算分解（Double Routing方案） 当未使能W4A8量化时，MoE EP采用Double Routing（AlltoAll）通信模式，具体流程如下： 1. Routing：使用npumoeinitroutingv2对token进行初始路由和排序； 2. Dispatch（AlltoAll）：通过dist.alltoallsingle将token按专家归属分发到对应Rank，同时交换tokensperexpert信息用于确定接收数量； 3. Re-routing：使用npumoererouting对接收到的token进行二次排序； 4. GMM计算：通过npugroupedmatmul完成专家计算； 5. Combine（AlltoAll）：将专家计算结果通过dist.alltoallsingle回传到原始Rank； 6. Finalize Routing：使用npumoefinalizerouting完成最终的结果归约。 融合算子优化 Prefill场景下，为减少量化引入的额外算子开销，将归一化、残差加法与量化操作进行融合： 融合RMSNorm + MX量化 通过使能torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormdynamicmxquant融合算子，将残差加法、RMSNorm归一化和MXFP8动态量化合并为一次计算，避免中间结果的反复读写： python hiddenstatesmx, residual, hiddenstatesscale, = \ torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormdynamicmxquant( hiddenstates, pastresidual, normweight, beta=None, epsilon=varianceepsilon, roundmode='rint', dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn ) 当残差为None时（首层），使用torchnpu.npurmsnormdynamicmxquant完成RMSNorm + MX量化融合。 融合RMSNorm + Cast MoE前的归一化需要同时输出FP32（用于gate计算）和BF16（用于专家计算）两种精度，通过使能torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormcast融合算子，将残差加法、RMSNorm和数据类型转换合并： python hiddenstatesfp32, hiddenstatesbf16, , residual = \ torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormcast( hiddenstates, residual, normweight, epsilon ) 配置说明 在YAML配置文件中设置Prefill SP+TP与MoE EP相关参数： yaml parallelconfig: attntpsize: 4 # Attention SP/TP并行度，Prefill时同时作为序列并行度 moetpsize: 1 # MoE TP大小，EP场景下设为1 moeepsize: 4 # MoE EP大小，需与attntpsize相等以启用SP优化路径 参数约束： 参数 约束条件 说明 --------- attntpsize worldsize % attntpsize == 0 Attention并行度 moeepsize worldsize % moeepsize == 0 MoE专家并行度 attntpsize == moeepsize 推荐相等 启用Prefill SP优化路径（prefillopt） seqlen 需能被attntpsize整除 不足时自动padding对齐 附录 环境部署以及样例执行

Low-Latency Inference Performance Optimization Practices for Qwen3-MoE on Atlas A3 and 950 Training/Inference Clusters Overview This document describes NPU-based low-latency inference optimization strategies for the Qwen3-MoE model. On the Atlas A3 training/inference series, Decode uses an 8-card deployment to achieve single-batch inference latency below 20 ms in BF16 scenarios. On the Atlas 950 PR training/inference series, Decode uses a 4-card deployment to achieve single-batch Prefill latency below 280 ms and Decode latency below 24 ms in 4K W4A8 mixed-precision inference scenarios. Tensor Parallel (TP) Optimization for Low-Latency Scenarios Attention TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy The tensor partitioning strategy for Attention can be divided into QKV-head partitioning and linear-layer partitioning. When partitioning QKV heads, the multi-head computation mechanism of attention makes tensor partitioning straightforward: each head is computed independently, and the results are then concatenated. Assume that an attention layer needs to partition numheads queries by attntpsize. numheads must be divisible by attntpsize, and the number of query heads placed on each card is numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize. The numbers of key and value heads are equal and may be less than or equal to the number of query heads (they are smaller in MQA and GQA scenarios). To ensure that each card has at least one key head and one value head, the number of key or value heads on each card is calculated as numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1). The arrangement of QKV heads across multiple cards is shown in the following figure. attentiontp For the linear layer oproj, row partitioning is used. Computation Decomposition This optimization strategy first merges the Q, K, and V linear-layer computations into one Matmul (mergedqkvproj in the figure) to improve computation performance. After splitting the output of mergedqkvproj into Q, K, and V, it normalizes Q and K and applies rotary positional encoding, computes attention (Fusedinferattentionscore in the figure), and finally outputs the result through the oproj layer. attentioncalcu MoE TP Optimization Partitioning Strategy Assume that the partition count of the model's MoE layer is moetpsize and the number of experts is expertnum. Tensor partitioning is applied to the MoE layer. Each expert is equivalent to an MLP layer, so its partitioning method is similar to MLP tensor partitioning. Specifically, gateproj and upproj are column-partitioned, while downproj is row-partitioned. The gateproj and upproj linear layers are also merged for computation to obtain w13weight. Computation Decomposition Each expert layer contains three Matmul operations: gateproj, upproj, and downproj. The specific computation is x = down( SiLU(gate(x))up(x) ). This optimization concatenates the tensor-partitioned gateproj and upproj and then enables the torchnpu.npuswiglu (Chinese) fused operator API. This operator performs the following two computations: Split input x into two parts along the last dimension: x = torch.chunk(x, 2, -1). Compute and return SiLU(x[0]) x[1]. By merging gateproj and upproj for computation, this optimization improves overall computation efficiency. moecalcu Enabling Fused Operators Enabling GMM and Optimizing Routing In the MoE module, processing each expert with a for loop and separately computing expertnum feed-forward networks (FFNs) can result in low computation efficiency. CANN provides the GroupedMatmul operator, which computes multiple experts simultaneously to improve computation and data-movement efficiency. For the specific implementation, see the moeinfertp and moeinferfusion functions in the Qwen3MoeSparseMoeBlock class. Fast expert selection: When calculating routing scores between experts and tokens, the torchnpu.npumoegatingtopksoftmax (Chinese) fused operator can replace the original multi-operator sequence of topk followed by softmax, calculating token-expert scores more quickly. Efficient sorting and token routing: Enable the torchnpu.npumoeinitrouting (Chinese) fused operator to perform MoE routing and obtain the expert order. Enable the torchnpu.npumoecomputeexperttokens (Chinese) fused operator to obtain the number of tokens to be processed by each expert. Enable the torchnpu.npumoefinalizerouting (Chinese) fused operator to reorder the tokens after expert computation and calculate their weighted sum to obtain the final output. High-performance expert computation: Enable the torchnpu.npugroupedmatmul (Chinese) fused operator to perform matrix multiplications for multiple experts and improve computation and data-movement efficiency. RmsNorm Operator Optimization Enabling the torchnpu.npurmsnorm (Chinese) operator improves model inference performance. RmsNorm is a normalization operation commonly used in large models. Compared with LayerNorm, it omits the mean-subtraction step. FlashAttention Fused Operator Optimization Enable torch.ops.npu.npufusedinferattentionscore (Chinese), a FlashAttention operator that supports graph mode in inference scenarios. It supports both full-computation and incremental-computation scenarios. Enabling Graph Mode Static graphs provide better inference performance. Qwen3MoeRunner overrides the graphcompile function of ModelRunner in modelrunner.py to compile the model into a static graph. Enabling Graph Compilation Cache In model inference, enabling the graph compilation cache stores the compiled static graph and avoids compiling the model for every inference run, thereby improving inference performance. For an example, see the use of graphcompile in Qwen3MoeRunner: python if self.enablecachecompile: casename = "compilecache/" + os.getenv("CASENAME") cachedir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(file)), casename) self.model.decode = tng.inference.cachecompile(self.model.decode, cachedir=cachedir, config=compilerconfig, dynamic=True, fullgraph=True, gecache=True) The default cache path is ./compilecache/CASENAME. Enabling AIV Expansion for Collective Communication Use the device's Vector Cores to accelerate collective communication operations. For details, see the HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE environment variable (Chinese): shell export HCCLOPEXPANSIONMODE=AIV Prefill Optimization for High-Throughput Scenarios (Attention SP+TP, MoE EP) Overview In Prefill inference, the model must process the complete input sequence at once, resulting in high computation intensity. To maximize throughput under TTFT latency constraints, a combined strategy of Attention sequence parallelism (SP), tensor parallelism (TP), and MoE expert parallelism (EP) is used together with MXFP8/MXFP4 quantization and multi-operator fusion, significantly reducing computation and communication overhead in Prefill. Attention SP+TP Optimization Parallel Strategy Selection Most Prefill operators are compute-bound. After TP partitioning, the sequence length on each card is shorter, but the AllReduce communication volume is proportional to the full sequence. SP partitions along the sequence dimension, so each card processes only a subsequence of length seqlen // attntpsize. Its communication operator is AlltoAll, which transfers less data and can be combined with low-bit quantization. Considering communication volume, data type, and additionally introduced operators, Attention in Prefill uses hybrid SP+TP parallelism: Communication before FA: Use AllGather to aggregate the subsequences from all ranks into the complete sequence, with MXFP8 quantization to reduce communication volume. Communication after FA: Use AlltoAll to redistribute the output of oproj to all ranks along the sequence dimension, with MXFP8 quantization. Partitioning Strategy The input sequence is evenly partitioned along the token dimension by attntpsize, and each rank processes seqlen // attntpsize tokens. The input sequence length must be divisible by attntpsize; otherwise, padding is applied for alignment. Rank 0: [token0, ..., token{S/P-1}] Rank 1: [token{S/P}, ..., token{2S/P-1}] ... Rank P-1: [token{(P-1)S/P}, ..., token{S-1}] Here, S is the sequence length, and P is attntpsize. Computation Decomposition The Attention computation flow in Prefill is as follows: 1. Sequence Partitioning and Embedding: Partition the input inputids by attntpsize; each rank performs Embedding only for its local subsequence. 2. AllGather Aggregation: Use dist.allgatherintotensor to aggregate hiddenstates from all ranks into the complete sequence. If MXFP8 quantization is enabled, aggregate hiddenstatesscale at the same time. 3. mergedqkvproj: Perform the QKV linear-layer computation on the aggregated complete sequence. 4. FlashAttention: Use npufusedinferattentionscorev2 to complete attention computation. 5. oproj + AlltoAll: oproj uses ReplicatedLinear (each card holds the complete weights). After MXFP8 quantization, the output is redistributed by AlltoAll along the sequence dimension, and each rank retains only the subsequence assigned to it. 6. Preparing MoE Input: The output shape after AlltoAll is (seqlen // attntpsize, hiddensize), which is used directly as the input to the MoE layer. attentionsptpprefill MoE EP Optimization Parallel Strategy Selection The MoE component supports both TP and EP. TP may partition the K or N axis of GMM too finely, reducing computation performance. Under EP, each rank holds some experts and uses communication to match tokens to experts; communication overhead is controllable when the number of eprank values is small. EP is further divided into an AllGather solution and a Double Routing (AlltoAll) solution: Parallel Strategy Communication Operator Communication Volume Applicable Scenario ------------ EP (AllGather) AllGather + ReduceScatter (B,S,H) × 2 Smaller data volume when eprank is small and topk > eprank EP (Double Routing) AlltoAll + AlltoAll (BS×topk/eprank, H) × 2 Large-EP scenarios; smaller data volume when eprank > topk For the current Qwen3-MoE model, topk=8. When eprank=4, topk > eprank, so the AllGather solution has a smaller communication volume and is preferred by default. Computation Decomposition (AllGather Solution, W4A8 Quantization) When W4A8 (MXFP4) quantization is enabled and attntpsize == moeepsize, MoE EP uses the AllGather + ReduceScatter communication pattern. The specific process is as follows: 1. MXFP8 Quantization: Apply npudynamicmxquant to input hiddenstates to obtain MXFP8-quantized data and its scale. 2. AllGather: Use dist.allgatherintotensor to aggregate quantized data, scale, topkids, and topkweight from all ranks, obtaining token information for the complete sequence. 3. Routing: Use npumoeinitroutingv2 to route the aggregated tokens to experts, retaining only tokens assigned to the expert range on the current rank. 4. GMM Computation: Use npugroupedmatmul (encapsulated in FusedMoEGMM ) to perform parallel matrix multiplication for multiple experts. 5. Finalize Routing: Use npumoefinalizerouting to reorder expert computation results by routing information and calculate their weighted sum. 6. ReduceScatter: Use dist.reducescattertensor to reduce and distribute partial results from all ranks. Each rank obtains the output of the subsequence assigned to it. Computation Decomposition (Double Routing Solution) When W4A8 quantization is not enabled, MoE EP uses the Double Routing (AlltoAll) communication pattern. The specific process is as follows: 1. Routing: Use npumoeinitroutingv2 for initial token routing and sorting. 2. Dispatch (AlltoAll): Use dist.alltoallsingle to dispatch tokens to the corresponding ranks according to expert ownership and exchange tokensperexpert information to determine receive counts. 3. Re-routing: Use npumoererouting to sort the received tokens a second time. 4. GMM Computation: Use npugroupedmatmul to perform expert computation. 5. Combine (AlltoAll): Use dist.alltoallsingle to return expert computation results to the original ranks. 6. Finalize Routing: Use npumoefinalizerouting to complete final result reduction. Fused Operator Optimization In Prefill, normalization, residual addition, and quantization are fused to reduce the additional operator overhead introduced by quantization: Fused RMSNorm + MX Quantization Enable the torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormdynamicmxquant fused operator to combine residual addition, RMSNorm, and MXFP8 dynamic quantization into one computation, avoiding repeated reads and writes of intermediate results: python hiddenstatesmx, residual, hiddenstatesscale, = \ torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormdynamicmxquant( hiddenstates, pastresidual, normweight, beta=None, epsilon=varianceepsilon, roundmode='rint', dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn ) When the residual is None (the first layer), use torchnpu.npurmsnormdynamicmxquant to fuse RMSNorm and MX quantization. Fused RMSNorm + Cast Normalization before MoE needs to output both FP32 (for gate computation) and BF16 (for expert computation). Enable the torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormcast fused operator to combine residual addition, RMSNorm, and data type conversion: python hiddenstatesfp32, hiddenstatesbf16, , residual = \ torchnpu.npuaddrmsnormcast( hiddenstates, residual, normweight, epsilon ) Configuration Description Set the parameters related to Prefill SP+TP and MoE EP in the YAML configuration file: yaml parallelconfig: attntpsize: 4 # Attention SP/TP degree; also used as the sequence parallel degree in Prefill moetpsize: 1 # MoE TP size; set to 1 in EP scenarios moeepsize: 4 # MoE EP size; must equal attntpsize to enable the SP optimization path Parameter constraints: Parameter Constraint Description --------- attntpsize worldsize % attntpsize == 0 Attention parallel degree moeepsize worldsize % moeepsize == 0 MoE expert parallel degree attntpsize == moeepsize Equal values recommended Enable the Prefill SP optimization path (prefillopt) seqlen Must be divisible by attntpsize Automatically padded for alignment when needed Appendix Environment Deployment and Sample Execution (Chinese)

daVinci-MagiHuman Model Inference Optimization on NPU The daVinci-MagiHuman model is a multimodal video generation model that provides text-to-video and text-plus-image-to-video capabilities. This document mainly introduces the NPU-based inference adaptation and optimization of the daVinci-MagiHuman model, which was verified on the Ascend Atlas A2/A3 environments. NPU Global Adaptation At the script entry, that is, samplevideo.py , add the following code: python import torch import torchnpu from torchnpu.contrib import transfertonpu Importing the torchnpu Package on NPU At the top of Python files that call torchnpu interfaces (such as torchnpu.npufusedinferattentionscore, torchnpu.npurotarymul, etc.), import the torchnpu package: python import torch Added import torchnpu NPU npufusedinferattentionscore Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npufusedinferattentionscore fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the FlashAttention operator. For details of this operator, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npufusedinferattentionscore operator is used in vae22module.py and ditmodule.py . Using the flashattnfunc function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def flashattnfunc(query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: b, s, n, d = query.shape , , kvn, = key.shape scale = 1.0 / (d 0.5) originaldtype = query.dtype query = query.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous() key = key.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous() value = value.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous() output, = torchnpu.npufusedinferattentionscore( query, key, value, numheads=n, numkeyvalueheads=kvn, scale=scale, inputlayout="BSND", sparsemode=0 ) return output.to(originaldtype) NPU npurotarymul Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npurotarymul fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the small-operator implementation in the source code. For details of npurotarymul, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npurotarymul operator is used in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py. Using the applyrotaryembnpu function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def applyrotaryembnpu(x, cos, sin): """ Apply rotary embedding using npurotarymul with pre-expanded cos/sin. x: (batchsize, seqlen, nheads, headdim) cos, sin: (1, seqlen, 1, rotarydim) - pre-expanded via cat([d, d], dim=-1) """ rodim = cos.shape[-1] if rodim == x.shape[-1]: return torchnpu.npurotarymul(x, cos, sin, rotarymode='half') xrot = torchnpu.npurotarymul(x[..., :rodim], cos, sin, rotarymode='half') return torch.cat([xrot, x[..., rodim:]], dim=-1) NPU npurmsnorm Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npurmsnorm fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the small-operator implementation in the source code. For details of npurmsnorm, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npurmsnorm operator is used in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py. Using the forwardsingleexpert function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def forwardsingleexpert(self, x: torch.Tensor, modalitydispatcher: Optional[ModalityDispatcher] = None, residual: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None): gamma = (self.weight + 1).contiguous() if residual is not None: gamma = gamma.to(torch.bfloat16) out, , newresidual = torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm( residual.to(gamma.dtype), x.to(gamma.dtype), gamma, self.eps) return out, newresidual out = torchnpu.npurmsnorm(x, gamma, self.eps)[0] return out NPU npuclippedswiglu Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npuclippedswiglu fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the small-operator implementation in the source code. For details of npuclippedswiglu, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npuclippedswiglu operator is used in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py. Using the swiglu7 function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def swiglu7(x, alpha: float = 1.702, limit: float = 7.0, outdtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None): outdtype = x.dtype if outdtype is None else outdtype xf32 = x.to(torch.float32).contiguous() out = torchnpu.npuclippedswiglu(xf32, alpha=alpha, limit=limit, bias=1.0, interleaved=True) return out.to(outdtype) NPU npufastgelu Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npufastgelu fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the small-operator implementation in the source code. For details of npufastgelu, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npufastgelu operator is used in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py. Using the gelu7 function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def gelu7(x, limit: float = 7.0, outdtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None): outdtype = x.dtype if outdtype is None else outdtype x = x.to(torch.float32) x.clamp(max=limit) x = torchnpu.npufastgelu(x) return x.to(outdtype) NPU npuaddrmsnorm Operator Adaptation This sample uses the npuaddrmsnorm fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the small-operator implementation in the source code. For details of npuaddrmsnorm, see the Ascend Community Documentation (Chinese). The npuaddrmsnorm operator is used in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py. Using the forwardsingleexpert function in models/davinci-magihuman/inference/model/dit/ditmodule.py as an example, the call is as follows: python def forwardsingleexpert(self, x: torch.Tensor, modalitydispatcher: Optional[ModalityDispatcher] = None, residual: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None): gamma = (self.weight + 1).contiguous() if residual is not None: gamma = gamma.to(torch.bfloat16) out, , newresidual = torchnpu.npuaddrmsnorm( residual.to(gamma.dtype), x.to(gamma.dtype), gamma, self.eps) return out, newresidual out = torchnpu.npurmsnorm(x, gamma, self.eps)[0] return out Offload Optimization The daVinci-MagiHuman open-source code runs on H100 GPU (80 GB memory) devices, but the single-card memory of the Ascend Atlas A2/A3 NPU is only 64 GB. Without offload, running the sr540p/sr540pti2v/sr1080p/sr1080pti2v modes would cause OOM (out of memory), so offload optimization was performed. First, the implementation of the CPUOffloadWrapper class in cpuoffloadwrapper.py was modified, adding the savecpucopies, prepareresidentbackup, disableoffload, and enableoffload functions, and modifying the runwithoptionaloffload function. Second, in videogenerate.py , the prepareresidentbackup, disableoffload, and enableoffload functions of the CPUOffloadWrapper class are called. For detailed changes, compare the differences of these two files between cann-recipes-infer and the daVinci-MagiHuman open-source repository.

NPU HunyuanImage-3.0模型推理优化实践 概述 本文主要介绍HunyuanImage-3.0模型基于NPU的推理优化策略。本文将介绍如何在Atlas A2/A3 系列产品上进行TP（Tensor Parallel）推理，及其他并行技术和算子融合优化方案。 切分策略 Attention TP优化 切分策略 对Attention的张量切分策略可以分为对QKV头的切分和对线性层的切分。 在对QKV头切分时，attention的多头计算机制可以方便进行张量切分，每个头先独立计算，再将结果concat起来。假设模型的attention层需要对numheads个query按照切分数量attntpsize进行切分，要求numheads必须能被attntpsize整除，每张卡放置query头个数为numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize；key和value头数相等，且可能小于等于query头个数（在MQA和GQA的场景下会小于）。为了确保每张卡至少放置一个key和value头，每张卡放置的key或value头数计算方法为 numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1)。QKV头在多卡上的排布情况如下图所示。 attentiontp 在对线性层oproj进行切分时，按照行切分即可。 计算分解 该优化策略先将Q、K、V的线性层计算合并为一次Matmul计算（图中mergedqkvproj），提升计算性能。将mergedqkvproj的输出结果按Q、K、V拆分后，对Q和V进行归一化操作并使用旋转位置编码，再计算attention（图中Fusedinferattentionscore），最后通过oproj层输出。 attentioncalcu MoE TP优化 切分策略 假设模型的MoE层的切分数量为moetpsize，专家个数为expertnum。对MoE层进行张量切分。具体做法是对gateproj与upproj进行列切分，对downproj进行行切分。同时对gateproj与upproj线性层采用合并计算的优化方式，得到w13weight。 计算分解 每个专家层存在gateproj、upproj与downproj三个matmul运算，具体运算为 x = down( SiLU(gate(x))up(x) )。本优化将张量切分后的gateproj和upproj进行concat操作，再使能 torchnpu.npuswiglu 融合算子接口优化，该算子能完成以下两步计算： 将输入的x沿最后一维切分为两块，即x = torch.chunk(x, 2, -1)。 计算并返回 SiLU(x[0]) x[1]。 本优化通过将gateproj与upproj合并计算，提升整体计算效率。 moecalcu MoE EP优化 在前述TP切分策略下，MoE的routing和finalizing与切分的份数无关，不论RANK数为多少，routing和finalizing的开销都一致，随着RANK数的增加，这部分的占比逐渐提升、无法优化。 因此，考虑对MoE部分改用EP切分方案，对MoE的gating切分S轴，之后的routing与finalizing计算量均变为原来的1/epsize倍；此时MoE部分需要采用DoubleRouting的方案： 1. 在GatingTopK之后使用InitRouting来确定当前RANK的token都需要分给哪些专家 2. 使用alltoall通信将tokensperexpert发送至对应RANK 3. 使用alltoall通信，将tokens发送至对应的RANK 4. 执行LocalRerouting，在每个RANK内按照专家序对token进行重排 5. 执行GroupedMatMul进行专家计算 6. 执行LocalFinalizeRerouting，排序回第二次alltoall后的排布 7. 使用alltoall把计算完的token发送回原本的TP域内对应RANK 8. 执行FinalizeRerouting，对专家计算的结果在TP域内进行累加 为了优化通信量，配合此EP+DoubleRouting方案，在qproj前使用AllGather对hiddenstates进行聚合，oproj后使用ReduceScatter对Attention的结果进行分发，这样可以为通算融合创造机会（AllGather与qkvproj融合、oproj与ReduceScatter融合）。 moedoublerouting 并行优化 MoE多流并行优化 MoE模块中，路由专家采用TP部署。共享专家的计算与路由专家在完成MoE计算后的通信可以通过多流并行机制使二者流水掩盖，使用allreduce的异步机制实现。排布情况如下图所示。 moemlpparallel VAE并行优化 本样例对模型的VAE并行进行了使能。通过空间并行的方式实现，将大尺寸图像在高度和宽度维度上切分成多个块，分配给不同的NPU进程并行处理，可以加速原模型VAE推理。在 vaepatchparallel.py 脚本实现此优化。 以下VAE并行流程图展示了空间并行处理的完整执行路径： vaeparallel 1. 首先将输入张量按空间维度切分到多个进程，每个进程处理自己的局部块； 2. 然后在计算过程中根据不同操作的特点采用相应的通信策略——卷积操作通过与邻居交换边界数据来获取上下文，注意力操作通过全局收集所有K,V张量来保证计算完整性，插值操作通过扩展边界、计算后再裁剪来处理上采样； 3. 最后通过两阶段的收集过程将各个进程的局部结果按照原始的空间位置重新拼接成完整的输出张量。 CFG并行优化 本样例对模型的CFG并行进行了使能。 对于一张图的生成，CFG(Classifier Free Guidance)需要跑一个无条件的生成和一个有条件的生成，相当于网络跑了两个样本，可以把这两个样本拆分到两张卡上去跑，然后通过allgather通信操作互相获取对方的计算结果，得到最终的预测结果。以TP2+CFGP为例，排布情况如下图所示。 cfgparallel 使能融合算子 通算融合 在当前的EP方案中，attention部分的qkvproj之前需要先对hiddenstates进行AllGather，在oproj之后又需要对attnoutput进行ReduceScatter操作，计算与通信串行执行的情况下会存在大量的性能浪费。查询 Ascend Extension for PyTorch自定义API 可以找到合适的通算融合算子以实现掩盖、缩短端到端耗时。 AllGatherMM 对于AllGather与qkvproj，可以考虑使用 torchnpu.npuallgatherbasemm 进行替换。须注意的是，该算子仅支持2维tensor作为输入，且只能沿着第0轴切分。因此，调用此算子前需要先将hiddenstates的layout由[b s h]转为[(s b) h]，调用之后再转回[b s h]。注意调用时s轴必须在最内侧，否则会出现精度问题。 MMReduceScatter 对于oproj与ReduceScatter，可以考虑使用 torchnpu.npummreducescatterbase 进行替换。须注意的是，该算子仅支持2维tensor作为输入，且只能沿着第0轴切分。因此，调用此算子前需要先将hiddenstates的layout由[b n s d]转为[(s b) (n d)]，调用之后再转回[b s (n d)]。注意调用时s轴必须在最内侧，否则会出现精度问题(A2平台下暂未使能该融合算子)。 GMM使能&&Routing优化 在MoE模块中，如果通过for循环处理每个专家，单独计算expertnum个前馈神经网络（FFN），容易导致计算效率较低。CANN提供了GroupedMatmul算子，可以同时计算多个专家，从而提高计算和搬运效率。具体实现可参考在HunyuanMoE类中的npugroupedmatmul模式下的实现。 高效排序和token路由： 使能 torchnpu.npumoeinitrouting 融合算子，实现MoE routing计算，获取专家的排序； 使能 torchnpu.npumoecomputeexperttokens 融合算子，获取每个专家需要计算的token数； 使能 torchnpu.npumoefinalizerouting 融合算子，将专家计算完成后的token重新排布并加权求和，获得最终输出。 高性能专家计算：使能 torchnpu.npugroupedmatmul 融合算子，实现多个专家的矩阵乘计算，提高计算和搬运效率。 RmsNorm算子优化 通过使能 torchnpu.npurmsnorm 算子，能够提升模型的推理性能。RmsNorm是大模型常用的归一化操作，相比LayerNorm，其去掉了减去均值的部分。 消除冗余计算 消除旋转位置编码冗余cast算子 将cos, sin转成bfloat16 cos = realbatchedindexselect(cos, dim=1, idx=positionids).to(torch.bfloat16) sin = realbatchedindexselect(sin, dim=1, idx=positionids).to(torch.bfloat16) 旋转位置编码计算使用cos, sin if self.userotaryposemb: cos, sin = customposemb querystates, keystates = applyrotaryposemb(querystates, keystates, cos, sin) 在旋转位置编码计算时，querystates, keystates是实时获取的，数据类型为bfloat16，为了消除cos, sin从float32自动转化成bfloat16的冗余cast算子，在HunyuanImage3ForCausalMM类中将cos, sin转成bfloat16。 消除gate计算冗余cast算子 屏蔽外层的torch.autocast能力 with torch.npu.amp.autocast(enabled=False): if self.wg.weight.dtype == torch.float32: hiddenstates = hiddenstates.float() logits = self.wg(hiddenstates) 由于外部开启了torch.autocast且数据类型设置成了bfloat16，即使设置成了float32，在计算时依然会被转成bfloat16，出现多个冗余的cast算子，为了保持gate计算的精度，gate计算部分屏蔽外层的torch.autocast能力。 消除FA中scale的冗余计算 在每次调用FA算子时，默认会计算一次scale=1/math.sqrt(d)，这个操作是在CPU进行，会导致下发中断和device的等待，造成性能浪费。由于d是一个固定的整数，在config文件中指定，那么完全可以在初始化时将scale的值计算出来，并在后续调用FA的地方复用。 在 cann-recipes-infer 中，对此scale的计算被提到HunyuanImage3Model.init()中，作为一个成员变量存在，后续调用flashattnfuncnpu时均直接使用、不再重复计算。 消除timestepindex的冗余计算 在DecoderLayer中，计算FA前需要获取timestepindex用于确定causallen，其获取方式是timestepindex = gentimestepscatterindex[0, 0].item()，此处的item()操作是一个强同步操作，造成device计算的中断。事实上，gentimestepscatterindex的值在HunyuanImage3Text2ImagePipeline.call()的开头即确定下来并不再发生改变，因此可以将timestepindex的初始化提前至HunyuanImage3Text2ImagePipeline.call()的开头，并透传至causallen的计算处，以避免反复的Host2Device操作，提升总体性能。
