NPU HunyuanImage-3.0 Model Inference Optimization Practice Overview This document mainly introduces the NPU-based inference optimization strategies for the HunyuanImage-3.0 model. It describes how to perform TP (Tensor Parallel) inference on Atlas A2/A3 series products, as well as other parallel techniques and operator fusion optimization schemes. Splitting Strategy Attention TP Optimization Splitting Strategy The tensor splitting strategy for Attention can be divided into splitting the QKV heads and splitting the linear layers. When splitting the QKV heads, the multi-head computation mechanism of attention facilitates convenient tensor splitting: each head is computed independently first, and then the results are concatenated. Assuming the model's attention layer needs to split numheads query heads according to the split size attntpsize, numheads must be divisible by attntpsize, and the number of query heads placed on each card is numheadsperrank = numheads // attntpsize. The number of key and value heads is equal, and may be less than or equal to the number of query heads (it is smaller in MQA and GQA scenarios). To ensure that each card holds at least one key and value head, the number of key or value heads placed on each card is calculated as numkeyvalueheadsperrank = max(numkeyvalueheads // attntpsize, 1). The arrangement of QKV heads across multiple cards is shown in the figure below. attentiontp When splitting the linear layer oproj, row splitting is sufficient. Computation Decomposition This optimization strategy first merges the linear layer computations of Q, K, and V into a single Matmul computation (mergedqkvproj in the figure), improving compute performance. After splitting the output of mergedqkvproj into Q, K, and V, normalization is applied to Q and V with rotary position encoding, then attention is computed (Fusedinferattentionscore in the figure), and finally the output is produced through the oproj layer. attentioncalcu MoE TP Optimization Splitting Strategy Assuming the split size of the model's MoE layer is moetpsize and the number of experts is expertnum, tensor splitting is performed on the MoE layer. Specifically, gateproj and upproj are split by columns, and downproj is split by rows. At the same time, the merged-computation optimization is applied to the gateproj and upproj linear layers to obtain w13weight. Computation Decomposition Each expert layer has three matmul operations: gateproj, upproj, and downproj. The specific operation is x = down( SiLU(gate(x))up(x) ). This optimization concatenates the split gateproj and upproj, then enables the torchnpu.npuswiglu fused operator interface for optimization. This operator completes the following two computation steps: Splits the input x into two blocks along the last dimension, i.e., x = torch.chunk(x, 2, -1). Computes and returns SiLU(x[0]) x[1]. This optimization improves overall computational efficiency by merging the computation of gateproj and upproj. moecalcu MoE EP Optimization Under the aforementioned TP splitting strategy, MoE routing and finalizing are independent of the split count. Regardless of the number of RANKs, the overhead of routing and finalizing remains the same. As the number of RANKs increases, the proportion of this part gradually grows and cannot be optimized. Therefore, the MoE part is switched to the EP splitting scheme. The gating of the MoE is split along the S axis, and the computation of both routing and finalizing afterward becomes 1/epsize of the original. At this point, the MoE part needs to adopt the DoubleRouting scheme: 1. After GatingTopK, use InitRouting to determine which experts the tokens on the current RANK need to be distributed to 2. Use alltoall communication to send tokensperexpert to the corresponding RANKs 3. Use alltoall communication to send tokens to the corresponding RANKs 4. Execute LocalRerouting to reorder tokens by expert order within each RANK 5. Execute GroupedMatMul for expert computation 6. Execute LocalFinalizeRerouting to restore the arrangement after the second alltoall 7. Use alltoall to send the computed tokens back to the corresponding RANKs in the original TP domain 8. Execute FinalizeRerouting to accumulate the expert computation results within the TP domain To optimize communication volume, this EP+DoubleRouting scheme uses AllGather before qproj to aggregate hiddenstates, and uses ReduceScatter after oproj to distribute the attention results. This creates opportunities for compute-communication fusion (AllGather fused with qkvproj, oproj fused with ReduceScatter). moedoublerouting Parallel Optimization MoE Multi-Stream Parallel Optimization In the MoE module, the routed experts are deployed with TP. The computation of the shared expert and the communication of the routed experts after completing MoE computation can be pipelined and hidden through the multi-stream parallel mechanism, implemented using the asynchronous allreduce mechanism. The arrangement is shown in the figure below. moemlpparallel VAE Parallel Optimization This example enables VAE parallelism for the model. Implemented through spatial parallelism, large-size images are split into multiple blocks along the height and width dimensions and assigned to different NPU processes for parallel processing, which can accelerate the VAE inference of the original model. This optimization is implemented in the vaepatchparallel.py script. The following VAE parallelism flow chart shows the complete execution path of spatial parallel processing: vaeparallel 1. First, the input tensor is split across multiple processes along the spatial dimension, and each process processes its own local blocks; 2. Then, during computation, corresponding communication strategies are adopted based on the characteristics of different operations — convolution operations obtain context by exchanging boundary data with neighbors, attention operations guarantee computational completeness by globally collecting all K and V tensors, and interpolation operations handle upsampling by expanding boundaries, computing, and then cropping; 3. Finally, through a two-stage collection process, the local results of each process are reassembled into a complete output tensor according to the original spatial positions. CFG Parallel Optimization This example enables CFG parallelism for the model. For the generation of one image, CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) needs to run one unconditional generation and one conditional generation, which is equivalent to the network running two samples. These two samples can be split onto two cards, and then the allgather communication operation is used to obtain each other's computation results, producing the final prediction result. Taking TP2+CFGP as an example, the arrangement is shown in the figure below. cfgparallel Enabling Fused Operators Compute-Communication Fusion In the current EP scheme, hiddenstates needs to be AllGather-ed before qkvproj in the attention part, and attnoutput needs to be ReduceScatter-ed after oproj. When computation and communication are executed serially, a large amount of performance is wasted. Refer to the Ascend Extension for PyTorch Custom APIs to find suitable compute-communication fusion operators to hide and shorten the end-to-end latency. AllGatherMM For AllGather and qkvproj, you can consider using torchnpu.npuallgatherbasemm as a replacement. Note that this operator only supports 2-dimensional tensors as input and can only split along the 0th axis. Therefore, before calling this operator, you need to convert the layout of hiddenstates from [b s h] to [(s b) h], and convert it back to [b s h] after the call. Note that the s axis must be the innermost when calling, otherwise accuracy issues may occur. MMReduceScatter For oproj and ReduceScatter, you can consider using torchnpu.npummreducescatterbase as a replacement. Note that this operator only supports 2-dimensional tensors as input and can only split along the 0th axis. Therefore, before calling this operator, you need to convert the layout of hiddenstates from [b n s d] to [(s b) (n d)], and convert it back to [b s (n d)] after the call. Note that the s axis must be the innermost when calling, otherwise accuracy issues may occur (this fused operator is not yet enabled on the A2 platform). GMM Enabling && Routing Optimization In the MoE module, processing each expert through a for loop and computing the expertnum feedforward neural networks (FFNs) individually can easily lead to low computational efficiency. CANN provides the GroupedMatmul operator, which can compute multiple experts simultaneously, thereby improving computation and data movement efficiency. For the specific implementation, refer to the npugroupedmatmul mode in the HunyuanMoE class. Efficient sorting and token routing: Enable the torchnpu.npumoeinitrouting fused operator to implement MoE routing computation and obtain the expert sorting; Enable the torchnpu.npumoecomputeexperttokens fused operator to obtain the number of tokens each expert needs to compute; Enable the torchnpu.npumoefinalizerouting fused operator to rearrange the tokens after expert computation and perform weighted summation to obtain the final output. High-performance expert computation: Enable the torchnpu.npugroupedmatmul fused operator to implement matrix multiplication computation for multiple experts, improving computation and data movement efficiency. RmsNorm Operator Optimization Enabling the torchnpu.npurmsnorm operator can improve the model's inference performance. RmsNorm is a normalization operation commonly used in large models; compared with LayerNorm, it removes the part that subtracts the mean. Eliminating Redundant Computation Eliminating the Redundant cast Operator in Rotary Position Encoding Convert cos, sin to bfloat16 cos = realbatchedindexselect(cos, dim=1, idx=positionids).to(torch.bfloat16) sin = realbatchedindexselect(sin, dim=1, idx=positionids).to(torch.bfloat16) The rotary position encoding computation uses cos, sin if self.userotaryposemb: cos, sin = customposemb querystates, keystates = applyrotaryposemb(querystates, keystates, cos, sin) During the rotary position encoding computation, querystates and keystates are obtained in real time with data type bfloat16. To eliminate the redundant cast operator that automatically converts cos, sin from float32 to bfloat16, cos and sin are converted to bfloat16 in the HunyuanImage3ForCausalMM class. Eliminating the Redundant cast Operator in gate Computation Disable the outer torch.autocast capability with torch.npu.amp.autocast(enabled=False): if self.wg.weight.dtype == torch.float32: hiddenstates = hiddenstates.float() logits = self.wg(hiddenstates) Since torch.autocast is enabled externally and the data type is set to bfloat16, even if it is set to float32, it will still be converted to bfloat16 during computation, resulting in multiple redundant cast operators. To maintain the accuracy of the gate computation, the gate computation part disables the outer torch.autocast capability. Eliminating Redundant Computation of scale in FA Each time the FA operator is called, scale=1/math.sqrt(d) is computed by default. This operation is performed on the CPU, which causes an interruption in task dispatch and device waiting, wasting performance. Since d is a fixed integer specified in the config file, the value of scale can be computed at initialization and reused at subsequent FA call sites. In cann-recipes-infer, the computation of this scale is moved to HunyuanImage3Model.init() and exists as a member variable. Subsequent calls to flashattnfuncnpu use it directly without recomputing it. Eliminating Redundant Computation of timestepindex In DecoderLayer, timestepindex needs to be obtained before computing FA to determine causallen. It is obtained via timestepindex = gentimestepscatterindex[0, 0].item(). This item() operation is a strongly synchronous operation that causes an interruption in device computation. In fact, the value of gentimestepscatterindex is determined at the beginning of HunyuanImage3Text2ImagePipeline.call() and does not change afterward. Therefore, the initialization of timestepindex can be moved forward to the beginning of HunyuanImage3Text2ImagePipeline.call() and passed through to where causallen is computed, avoiding repeated Host2Device operations and improving overall performance. NPU HunyuanVideo模型推理优化实践 优化背景 HunyuanVideo是腾讯发布的一款多模态视频生成模型，是当前开源社区热门的文本视频生成模型。本方案基于昇腾Atlas A2环境优化HunyuanVideo代码，实现了NPU适配和较高的推理性能。 HunyuanVideo基于DiT架构，在生成一个5s的720p视频（共129帧），大约有一个序列长度为119k的3D full Attention计算，attention计算占据模型端到端耗时的81%，DiT占据端到端耗时的95%。为了提高HunyuanVideo的推理性能，本样例做了以下优化。 优化总览 本方案中涉及的优化策略如下表所示： 优化方案 优化角度 方案介绍 ------- -------- -------- NPU开箱，FA融合算子适配 融合算子 使用CANN内部的 FIA融合算子 替代transformer中attention计算，算子内部通过tiling策略减少运行时的动态内存，并且加速attention计算。 NPU RMS Norm融合算子适配 融合算子 RMSNorm(Root Mean Square Layer Normalization, 均方根层归一化)是一种更高效的layernorm策略，使用CANN内部的 RMSNorm融合算子 替代小算子实现，减少小算子运行时不必要的内部开销（例如搬运、算子头尾开销），实现加速效果。 NPU ROPE融合算子适配 融合算子 Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) 旋转位置编码，通过对输入特征进行二维平面旋转注入位置信息。使用CANN内部的 npurotarymul融合算子 替代小算子实现，加速原理同上。 Ulysses序列并行 提高算力 将超长序列高效地切分到多个NPU上并行处理，每张卡负责处理自己负责的序列长度。具体在Attention以外的部分，Ulysses序列并行方法切的是序列长度，在Attention计算时改为切head num，以保证attention完整被计算 Ring Attention序列并行 提高算力 与Ulysses序列并行类似，但是在attention计算时，每张卡仍然负责处理自己负责的序列长度。为了保证attention完整被计算，需要在卡和卡之间循环传递KV块。 FBCache 减少计算量 DiT生成的原理是将噪声通过多个DiT时间步还原为符合语义的图像或视频。FBCache方法通过缓存两次DiT时间步的残差，在合适的时候用残差代替DiT时间步的实际输出。通过实际上减少推理步数来减少计算量，提高推理性能。FBCache使用第一个DiT Block的输出判断能否复用残差。 TeaCache 减少计算量 与FBCache类似，区别在与TeaCache使用第一个img modulate的输出判断能否复用残差。 Ulysses Anything Attention 功能泛化 扩展Ulysses序列并行，支持任意头数配置，通过动态填充和对齐机制，突破标准Ulysses要求头数必须被并行度整除的限制。 VAE并行 提高算力 与序列并行策略相似，每张设备卡仅负责处理分配给自身的序列部分。同时，为解决卷积操作中感受野受限的问题，本样例对每张卡的序列长度进行了补充，使其能够获得相邻设备卡上的部分序列信息。 VAE优化 减少计算量 使用空间换时间，将需要重复构造的mask缓存在内存，减少重复计算。 取消VAE offload 减少搬运 开启虚拟内存，可以提高可用内存空间，允许取消CPU-offload，避免频繁地将权重从host搬运到device。 FP8 量化注意力 降低显存带宽 通过per-block动态量化将注意力计算中的Q/K/V量化为FP8格式，显著降低显存带宽需求，提升推理性能。 MXFP8 矩阵量化 (A8W8) 降低显存带宽 对DiT中的Linear层采用MXFP8量化，实现8-bit激活与8-bit权重的矩阵乘法，降低显存占用和带宽需求，提高推理性能。 块稀疏 Attention 减少计算量 Sparse Attention通过计算分块在注意力计算的重要程度，以此为依据判断需要计算以及跳过哪些分块，通过减少FA计算量从而提升计算效率。 性能优化结果如下表，数据来自 Atlas A3。其中 baseline """ return torchnpu.npurmsnorm(x, self.weight, epsilon=self.eps)[0] Rotary融合算子适配 使用torchnpu内置的npurotarymul融合算子替代Rope小算子，可见 posemblayers.py 的applyrotaryemb函数（L163）。小算子实现如下： python xqout = (xq.float() cos + rotatehalf(xq.float()) sin).typeas(xq) xkout = (xk.float() cos + rotatehalf(xk.float()) sin).typeas(xk) 融合算子写法如下： python xqout = torchnpu.npurotarymul(xq, cos, sin, rotarymode="interleave") xkout = torchnpu.npurotarymul(xk, cos, sin, rotarymode="interleave") 序列并行 假设input的shape为B，S，N，D，分别代表（batch size，sequence，number of head，dimension），序列并行即将input沿着S维度进行切分，在多卡上实现更低的动态显存占用，和更高的DiT性能。 Ulysses Sequence Parallelism (SP)： 如图所示，首先将input沿着S维度切分为S/SP，其中SP为序列并行数量，输入模型，直到attn操作。考虑到多头自注意力计算时各个头是并行计算的，在attention以外的地方切分latent的模序列长度，在attn操作时，需要一次AllToAll通讯，交换每张卡存储的数据，等价为将input的shape从（B，S/SP，N，D）reshape为（B，S，N/SP，D）。即从切分序列长度改为切分head num。在attn结束后，由于每张卡实际仅计算1/SP的head的结果，所以需要再一次AllToAll通讯获得完整的attn结果。 Ring Attention Sequence Parallelism (SP)： 如图所示，首先将input沿着S维度切分为S/SP，其中SP为序列并行数量，输入模型。当attn计算时，保持本卡的1/SP的Q不动，通过P2P(Peer-To-Peer)，将当前维护的1/SP的KV对传递给下一张卡。每张卡循环接收其他卡的KV对，与本卡的Q计算注意力。 图片来源： feifeibear Ulysses Anything Attention 标准Ulysses序列并行要求注意力头数（numheads）必须能被序列并行度（ulyssesdegree）整除，这一限制在实际应用中可能导致配置不灵活的问题。Ulysses Anything Attention通过动态填充和分布式对齐机制，打破了这一限制，支持任意头数配置。 核心原理： 1. 动态填充（Padding）：当头数不能被并行度整除时，自动计算需要填充的头数，使填充后的头数能被并行度整除。 python hpad = worldsize - (h % worldsize) # 计算填充头数 newhlocal = (h + hpad) // worldsize # 每卡本地头数 2. 分布式对齐：仅最后一rank需要填充，其他rank保持原始数据，减少不必要的内存开销。 3. 填充约束：填充头数必须小于每卡本地头数，确保填充不会导致负优化。 代码实现： 填充逻辑位于 uaa.py ： python def maybepadqkvhead(x: torch.Tensor, h: int, worldsize: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, int]: """Maybe pad the head dimension to be divisible by worldsize.""" hpad = 0 if h % worldsize != 0: hpad = worldsize - (h % worldsize) newhlocal = (h + hpad) // worldsize # 约束：填充头数必须小于每卡本地头数 if hpad >= newhlocal: raise ValueError( f"Padding head num {hpad} should be less than new local head num {newhlocal}" ) x = F.pad(x, (0, 0, 0, hpad)).contiguous() return x, hpad 使用方式： python 启用 Ulysses Anything 模式 attn = UnifiedSPAttention( ulyssesgroup=ulyssesgroup, ringgroup=None, ulyssesanything=True # 关键参数 ) 示例： 配置 头数 并行度 填充数 每卡头数 -------------------------------------- 标准Ulysses 24 8 0 3 Ulysses Anything 30 8 2 4 Ulysses Anything 40 8 0 5 视频尺寸约束解除： 标准Ulysses序列并行对视频尺寸有严格约束：视频的高度H或宽度W必须满足 H % 16 % ulyssesdegree == 0 或 W % 16 % ulyssesdegree == 0。这意味着对于不同的并行度配置，需要选择特定的视频分辨率。 Ulysses Anything通过动态序列长度分配机制，解除了这一约束。其核心在于支持各rank的序列长度不一致，通过通信收集各rank的实际序列长度后再进行all-to-all操作： python 收集各rank的序列长度 outputsplitsizes = gathersizebycomm(slocal, self.ulyssespg) 使用实际的序列长度分配进行all-to-all x = fc.alltoallsingle(x, outputsplitsizes, inputsplitsizes, self.ulyssespg) 这使得任意视频尺寸都能适配任意的Ulysses并行度配置，极大提升了配置灵活性。 MXFP8 量化注意力 MXFP8量化注意力通过将注意力计算中的Q、K、V张量量化为MXFP8格式（npudynamicmxquant），显著降低显存带宽需求，特别适用于显存受限或带宽受限的场景。 量化原理 本方案采用MXFP8（Micro-scaling FP8）动态量化策略： 1. per-token/per-channel group MX量化：对 Q/K/V 分别做动态 MX 量化，每个块组独立计算缩放因子，缩放因子采用 E8M0 格式（纯指数表示），仅占1字节。 2. 差异化量化模式： Query/Key: 沿 hidden dim 方向分组，即FIAv2算子入参 quantmode=6。 Value: 沿 seqlen 方向分组，即FIAv2算子入参 quantmode=8。 3. FP8 E4M3格式：采用IEEE FP8 E4M3格式（4位指数，3位尾数），在动态范围和精度之间取得良好平衡。 代码实现 量化核心函数位于 faquant.py ： python def npumxfp8quant(x, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn, outputlayout="TND", axis=-1): """Perform MXFP8 dynamic quantization for NPU fused attention.""" b, s, n, d = x.shape if outputlayout == "TND": xtnd = x.contiguous().view(b s, n, d) xquant, xscale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant( xtnd, dsttype=dsttype, axis=axis ) return xquant, xscale 融合注意力计算： python def npumxfp8attn(q, k, v, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn, softmaxscale=None): """Perform MXFP8 quantized attention computation on NPU.""" b, s, n, d = q.shape kvs = k.shape[1] outdtype = q.dtype if softmaxscale is None: softmaxscale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) qquant, qscale = npumxfp8quant(q, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND") kquant, kscale = npumxfp8quant(k, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND") vquant, vscale = npumxfp8quant(v, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND", axis=0) attnout = torchnpu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2( qquant, kquant, vquant, actualseqqlen=actualseqlens(b, s, q.device), actualseqkvlen=actualseqlens(b, kvs, k.device), dequantscalequery=qscale, dequantscalekey=kscale, dequantscalevalue=vscale, numqueryheads=n, numkeyvalueheads=k.shape[2], softmaxscale=softmaxscale, inputlayout="TND", sparsemode=0, # non-sparse queryquantmode=6, # per-channel group quant keyquantmode=6, # per-channel group quant valuequantmode=8, # per-token group quant querydtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, keydtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, valuedtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, dequantscalequerydtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, dequantscalekeydtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, dequantscalevaluedtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, outdtype=outdtype )[0] return attnout.contiguous().view(b, s, n, d) 使用方式 独立使用量化注意力： python from module.faquant import npumxfp8attn output = npumxfp8attn(q, k, v, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn) 结合序列并行使用： python attn = UnifiedSPAttention( ulyssesgroup=ulyssesgroup, ringgroup=None, famxfp8=True # Per-token量化：对激活张量按token维度量化，每个token有独立的缩放因子。 2. Per-group量化：对权重按组量化，默认组大小为32，平衡精度与压缩率。 3. E8M0缩放因子：缩放因子采用E8M0格式（纯指数表示），仅占1字节。 代码实现 量化核心代码位于 mxfp8a8w8.py ： 动态量化Linear层： python def dynamicconvertmxfp8linear(module, originaldtype, paramstokeep=None): """Dynamically convert Linear layers to MXFP8 quantized format.""" for key, layer in module.namedmodules(): # 仅转换transformer块中的Linear层 if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear) and ('doubleblocks' in key or 'singleblocks' in key): # 跳过modulation层和1D权重 if len(layer.weight.shape) == 1 or 'mod' in key: continue # 动态量化权重为MXFP8格式 mxfp8weight, mxfp8scale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant( layer.weight.data, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn ) layer.weight.data = mxfp8weight setattr(layer, "weightscale", mxfp8scale) # 替换forward为量化版本 setattr(layer, "forward", lambda input, m=layer: mxfp8linearforward(m, originaldtype, input)) 量化Linear层前向传播： python def mxfp8linearforward(layer, originaldtype, x): """Forward pass for MXFP8 quantized linear layer.""" # 动态量化输入为MXFP8格式 xquant, xscale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant(x, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn) # 执行量化矩阵乘法 (A8W8) output = torchnpu.npuquantmatmul( xquant, layer.weight.T, pertokenscale=xscale, # 输入缩放因子 bias=layer.bias.to(torch.float32), scale=layer.weightscale.permute(1, 0, 2), # 权重缩放因子 outputdtype=originaldtype, # 输出BF16/FP16 pertokenscaledtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, scaledtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, groupsizes=[1, 1, 32] # 权重量化组大小 ) return output 使用方式 python from hyvideo.modules.mxfp8a8w8 import dynamicconvertmxfp8linear 在模型加载后，转换Linear层为MXFP8格式 dynamicconvertmxfp8linear(ditmodel, originaldtype=torch.bfloat16) 量化范围 层类型 是否量化 说明 ------------------------ doubleblocks中的Linear ✓ 双流注意力块的投影层 singleblocks中的Linear ✓ 单流注意力块的投影层 Modulation层 (adaLN) ✗ 保持原始精度，保证调制精度 1D权重层 ✗ 不适合量化 性能收益 显存占用：权重从BF16（2字节）压缩到FP8（1字节），显存占用减半 带宽需求：权重加载带宽降低50% 计算效率：利用NPU的量化矩阵乘法硬件加速 Dit Cache DIT-Cache作为扩散模型推理加速的缓存框架，通过复用/预测已有的结果，减少冗余前向计算。其加速逻辑可清晰的分为Step-level和Block-level范式，Step-level通过判断不同采样步数step间的特定特征差异，通过阈值比较，决定是否跳过完整的step计算，直接复用或者预测缓存结果；Block-level以block为粒度（通常是attention模块和mlp模块）判断是否直接复用或者预测缓存结果。 本样例集成了Step-level的dit cache方案，支持 FBCache 和 TeaCache 。 TeaCache TeaCache是一种针对DiT的推理加速优化点，通过缓存相邻DiT step间输出的差值，复用此差值从而跳过当前DiT step，达到加速推理的结果。 首先选取Timestep Embedding Modulated Noisy Input的$\ell1$距离反应当前timestep和上一步timestep的输出差异。 如果两者的输出差异大于一个阈值（即，累加的$\ell1$距离>阈值），则代表当前timestep需要完整计算，将$\ell1$距离清零；如果两者的输出差异小于一个阈值（即，累加的$\ell1$距离 float: """ Synchronize a scalar value across all SP ranks. NPU HunyuanVideo Model Inference Optimization Practice Optimization Background HunyuanVideo is a multimodal video generation model released by Tencent and is currently a popular text-to-video generation model in the open-source community. This solution optimizes the HunyuanVideo code based on the Ascend Atlas A2 environment, achieving NPU adaptation and high inference performance. HunyuanVideo is based on the DiT architecture. To generate a 5s 720p video (129 frames in total), there is approximately one 3D full Attention computation with a sequence length of 119k. Attention computation accounts for 81% of the model's end-to-end latency, and DiT accounts for 95% of the end-to-end latency. To improve the inference performance of HunyuanVideo, this example makes the following optimizations. Optimization Overview The optimization strategies involved in this solution are shown in the following table: Optimization Scheme Optimization Aspect Scheme Introduction ------- -------- -------- NPU out-of-the-box, FA fused operator adaptation Fused operator Use the CANN built-in FIA fused operator to replace the attention computation in the transformer. Inside the operator, a tiling strategy reduces runtime dynamic memory and accelerates the attention computation. NPU RMS Norm fused operator adaptation Fused operator RMSNorm (Root Mean Square Layer Normalization) is a more efficient layernorm strategy. Use the CANN built-in RMSNorm fused operator to replace the small-operator implementation, reducing unnecessary internal overhead of small operators at runtime (such as data movement and operator head/tail overhead) to achieve acceleration. NPU ROPE fused operator adaptation Fused operator Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) injects position information by rotating the input features in a two-dimensional plane. Use the CANN built-in npurotarymul fused operator to replace the small-operator implementation; the acceleration principle is the same as above. Ulysses sequence parallelism Increase compute power Efficiently split ultra-long sequences across multiple NPUs for parallel processing, with each card responsible for processing its own sequence length. Specifically, outside of Attention, the Ulysses sequence parallelism method splits the sequence length; during Attention computation, it switches to splitting the head num to ensure that attention is fully computed. Ring Attention sequence parallelism Increase compute power Similar to Ulysses sequence parallelism, but during attention computation, each card still processes its own sequence length. To ensure that attention is fully computed, KV blocks need to be passed cyclically between cards. FBCache Reduce computation The principle of DiT generation is to restore noise into semantically meaningful images or videos through multiple DiT time steps. The FBCache method caches the residuals of two DiT time steps and, at the appropriate time, replaces the actual output of a DiT time step with the residual. It reduces the computation by effectively reducing the number of inference steps, improving inference performance. FBCache uses the output of the first DiT Block to determine whether the residual can be reused. TeaCache Reduce computation Similar to FBCache, the difference is that TeaCache uses the output of the first img modulate to determine whether the residual can be reused. Ulysses Anything Attention Function generalization Extends Ulysses sequence parallelism to support arbitrary head count configurations. Through dynamic padding and alignment mechanisms, it breaks the limitation of standard Ulysses that requires the head count to be divisible by the parallelism degree. VAE parallelism Increase compute power Similar to the sequence parallelism strategy, each device card only processes the sequence portion assigned to it. At the same time, to solve the limited receptive field problem in convolution operations, this example supplements the sequence length of each card so that it can obtain partial sequence information from adjacent device cards. VAE optimization Reduce computation Use space for time by caching the masks that need to be repeatedly constructed in memory, reducing repeated computation. Disable VAE offload Reduce data movement Enable virtual memory to increase available memory space, allowing CPU-offload to be disabled and avoiding frequent weight movement from host to device. FP8 quantized attention Reduce memory bandwidth Quantize Q/K/V in attention computation to FP8 format through per-block dynamic quantization, significantly reducing memory bandwidth requirements and improving inference performance. MXFP8 matrix quantization (A8W8) Reduce memory bandwidth Apply MXFP8 quantization to the Linear layers in DiT, achieving matrix multiplication with 8-bit activations and 8-bit weights, reducing memory usage and bandwidth requirements and improving inference performance. Block sparse Attention Reduce computation Sparse Attention computes the importance of blocks in attention computation and uses it as a basis to determine which blocks need to be computed and which to skip, improving computational efficiency by reducing the FA computation. The small-operator implementation is as follows: python xqout = (xq.float() cos + rotatehalf(xq.float()) sin).typeas(xq) xkout = (xk.float() cos + rotatehalf(xk.float()) sin).typeas(xk) The fused operator is written as follows: python xqout = torchnpu.npurotarymul(xq, cos, sin, rotarymode="interleave") xkout = torchnpu.npurotarymul(xk, cos, sin, rotarymode="interleave") Sequence Parallelism Assuming the shape of the input is B, S, N, D, representing (batch size, sequence, number of head, dimension) respectively, sequence parallelism splits the input along the S dimension, achieving lower dynamic memory usage and higher DiT performance on multiple cards. Ulysses Sequence Parallelism (SP): As shown in the figure, the input is first split into S/SP along the S dimension, where SP is the sequence parallelism count, and fed into the model until the attn operation. Considering that each head is computed in parallel in multi-head self-attention computation, the sequence length of the latent is split outside of attention, while at the attn operation, one AllToAll communication is needed to exchange the data stored on each card, which is equivalent to reshaping the shape of the input from (B, S/SP, N, D) to (B, S, N/SP, D). That is, from splitting the sequence length to splitting the head num. After attn ends, since each card actually computes only the results of 1/SP of the heads, another AllToAll communication is needed to obtain the complete attn result. Ring Attention Sequence Parallelism (SP): As shown in the figure, the input is first split into S/SP along the S dimension, where SP is the sequence parallelism count, and fed into the model. During attn computation, the 1/SP of Q maintained on the current card is kept unchanged, and the currently maintained 1/SP KV pairs are passed to the next card via P2P (Peer-To-Peer). Each card cyclically receives KV pairs from other cards and computes attention with its own Q. Image source: feifeibear Ulysses Anything Attention Standard Ulysses sequence parallelism requires that the number of attention heads (numheads) be divisible by the sequence parallelism degree (ulyssesdegree). This limitation may cause configuration inflexibility in practical applications. Ulysses Anything Attention breaks this limitation through dynamic padding and distributed alignment mechanisms, supporting arbitrary head count configurations. Core principle: 1. Dynamic padding: When the head count is not divisible by the parallelism degree, the number of heads to pad is automatically calculated so that the padded head count is divisible by the parallelism degree. python hpad = worldsize - (h % worldsize) # Calculate the number of heads to pad newhlocal = (h + hpad) // worldsize # Local head count per card 2. Distributed alignment: Only the last rank needs padding; other ranks keep the original data, reducing unnecessary memory overhead. 3. Padding constraint: The number of padded heads must be less than the local head count per card, ensuring that padding does not cause negative optimization. Code implementation: The padding logic is located in uaa.py : python def maybepadqkvhead(x: torch.Tensor, h: int, worldsize: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, int]: """Maybe pad the head dimension to be divisible by worldsize.""" hpad = 0 if h % worldsize != 0: hpad = worldsize - (h % worldsize) newhlocal = (h + hpad) // worldsize # Constraint: the number of padded heads must be less than the local head count per card if hpad >= newhlocal: raise ValueError( f"Padding head num {hpad} should be less than new local head num {newhlocal}" ) x = F.pad(x, (0, 0, 0, hpad)).contiguous() return x, hpad How to use: python Enable Ulysses Anything mode attn = UnifiedSPAttention( ulyssesgroup=ulyssesgroup, ringgroup=None, ulyssesanything=True # Key parameter ) Example: Configuration Head count Parallelism degree Padded heads Heads per card -------------------------------------- Standard Ulysses 24 8 0 3 Ulysses Anything 30 8 2 4 Ulysses Anything 40 8 0 5 Removing the video size constraint: Standard Ulysses sequence parallelism imposes strict constraints on video size: the height H or width W of the video must satisfy H % 16 % ulyssesdegree == 0 or W % 16 % ulyssesdegree == 0. This means that for different parallelism degree configurations, specific video resolutions need to be selected. Ulysses Anything removes this constraint through a dynamic sequence length allocation mechanism. Its core lies in supporting inconsistent sequence lengths across ranks: it collects the actual sequence length of each rank through communication and then performs the all-to-all operation: python Collect the sequence length of each rank outputsplitsizes = gathersizebycomm(slocal, self.ulyssespg) Perform all-to-all using the actual sequence length allocation x = fc.alltoallsingle(x, outputsplitsizes, inputsplitsizes, self.ulyssespg) This allows any video size to adapt to any Ulysses parallelism degree configuration, greatly improving configuration flexibility. MXFP8 Quantized Attention MXFP8 quantized attention quantizes the Q, K, and V tensors in attention computation to the MXFP8 format (npudynamicmxquant), significantly reducing memory bandwidth requirements. It is especially suitable for memory-constrained or bandwidth-constrained scenarios. Quantization Principle This scheme adopts the MXFP8 (Micro-scaling FP8) dynamic quantization strategy: 1. Per-token/per-channel group MX quantization: Dynamic MX quantization is applied to Q/K/V separately, with each block group independently computing its scaling factor. The scaling factor uses the E8M0 format (pure exponent representation), occupying only 1 byte. 2. Differentiated quantization modes: Query/Key: Grouped along the hidden dim direction, i.e., the FIAv2 operator input parameter quantmode=6. Value: Grouped along the seqlen direction, i.e., the FIAv2 operator input parameter quantmode=8. 3. FP8 E4M3 format: Uses the IEEE FP8 E4M3 format (4-bit exponent, 3-bit mantissa), achieving a good balance between dynamic range and precision. Code Implementation The core quantization function is located in faquant.py : python def npumxfp8quant(x, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn, outputlayout="TND", axis=-1): """Perform MXFP8 dynamic quantization for NPU fused attention.""" b, s, n, d = x.shape if outputlayout == "TND": xtnd = x.contiguous().view(b s, n, d) xquant, xscale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant( xtnd, dsttype=dsttype, axis=axis ) return xquant, xscale Fused attention computation: python def npumxfp8attn(q, k, v, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn, softmaxscale=None): """Perform MXFP8 quantized attention computation on NPU.""" b, s, n, d = q.shape kvs = k.shape[1] outdtype = q.dtype if softmaxscale is None: softmaxscale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) qquant, qscale = npumxfp8quant(q, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND") kquant, kscale = npumxfp8quant(k, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND") vquant, vscale = npumxfp8quant(v, dsttype=dsttype, outputlayout="TND", axis=0) attnout = torchnpu.npufusedinferattentionscorev2( qquant, kquant, vquant, actualseqqlen=actualseqlens(b, s, q.device), actualseqkvlen=actualseqlens(b, kvs, k.device), dequantscalequery=qscale, dequantscalekey=kscale, dequantscalevalue=vscale, numqueryheads=n, numkeyvalueheads=k.shape[2], softmaxscale=softmaxscale, inputlayout="TND", sparsemode=0, # non-sparse queryquantmode=6, # per-channel group quant keyquantmode=6, # per-channel group quant valuequantmode=8, # per-token group quant querydtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, keydtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, valuedtype=torch.float8e4m3fn, dequantscalequerydtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, dequantscalekeydtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, dequantscalevaluedtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, outdtype=outdtype )[0] return attnout.contiguous().view(b, s, n, d) How to Use Using quantized attention independently: python from module.faquant import npumxfp8attn output = npumxfp8attn(q, k, v, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn) Using it with sequence parallelism: python attn = UnifiedSPAttention( ulyssesgroup=ulyssesgroup, ringgroup=None, famxfp8=True # Enable MXFP8 quantized attention ) Quantization Mode Description MXFP8 uses the npudynamicmxquant operator for dynamic MX quantization. The npufusedinferattentionscorev2 operator internally processes the following flow: 1. Dequantize the quantized values using the E8M0 scaling factors 2. Perform the attention computation (Q×K^T) 3. Apply Softmax 4. Perform the output computation (Attn×V) 5. Return the output in the original precision format Limitations MXFP8 quantized attention currently only supports Ulysses sequence parallelism and does not support Ring Attention It is recommended to run comparative tests in precision-sensitive scenarios and select appropriate quantization parameters MXFP8 Matrix Quantization (A8W8) MXFP8 quantization targets the Linear layers in DiT (such as MLP and projection layers), achieving matrix multiplication with 8-bit activations and 8-bit weights to further reduce memory usage and bandwidth requirements. Quantization Principle MXFP8 (Micro-scaling FP8) is a block-based quantized FP8 format using the E4M3FN data type (4-bit exponent, 3-bit mantissa): 1. Per-token quantization: Activations are quantized along the token dimension, with each token having an independent scaling factor. 2. Per-group quantization: Weights are quantized in groups, with a default group size of 32, balancing precision and compression ratio. 3. E8M0 scaling factor: The scaling factor uses the E8M0 format (pure exponent representation), occupying only 1 byte. Code Implementation The core quantization code is located in mxfp8a8w8.py : Dynamically quantized Linear layer: python def dynamicconvertmxfp8linear(module, originaldtype, paramstokeep=None): """Dynamically convert Linear layers to MXFP8 quantized format.""" for key, layer in module.namedmodules(): # Only convert Linear layers in transformer blocks if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear) and ('doubleblocks' in key or 'singleblocks' in key): # Skip modulation layers and 1D weights if len(layer.weight.shape) == 1 or 'mod' in key: continue # Dynamically quantize weights to MXFP8 format mxfp8weight, mxfp8scale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant( layer.weight.data, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn ) layer.weight.data = mxfp8weight setattr(layer, "weightscale", mxfp8scale) # Replace forward with the quantized version setattr(layer, "forward", lambda input, m=layer: mxfp8linearforward(m, originaldtype, input)) Quantized Linear layer forward pass: python def mxfp8linearforward(layer, originaldtype, x): """Forward pass for MXFP8 quantized linear layer.""" # Dynamically quantize the input to MXFP8 format xquant, xscale = torchnpu.npudynamicmxquant(x, dsttype=torch.float8e4m3fn) # Perform quantized matrix multiplication (A8W8) output = torchnpu.npuquantmatmul( xquant, layer.weight.T, pertokenscale=xscale, # Input scaling factor bias=layer.bias.to(torch.float32), scale=layer.weightscale.permute(1, 0, 2), # Weight scaling factor outputdtype=originaldtype, # Output BF16/FP16 pertokenscaledtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, scaledtype=torchnpu.float8e8m0fnu, groupsizes=[1, 1, 32] # 8卡VAE并行 本样例对模型的VAE并行进行了使能。通过空间并行的方式实现，将大尺寸图像在高度和宽度维度上切分成多个块，分配给不同的NPU进程并行处理，可以加速原模型VAE推理。在 vaepatchparallel.py 脚本实现此优化。 以下VAE并行流程图展示了空间并行处理的完整执行路径： 1. 首先将输入张量按空间维度切分到多个进程，每个进程处理自己的局部块； 2. 然后在计算过程中根据不同操作的特点采用相应的通信策略——卷积操作通过与邻居交换边界数据来获取上下文，注意力操作通过全局收集所有K,V张量来保证计算完整性，插值操作通过扩展边界、计算后再裁剪来处理上采样； 3. 最后通过两阶段的收集过程将各个进程的局部结果按照原始的空间位置重新拼接成完整的输出张量。 CFG并行 本样例对模型的CFG并行进行了使能。在 image2video.py (L432)实现： for stepidx, t in enumerate(tqdm(timesteps)): latentmodelinput = [latent.to(self.device)] timestep = [t] timestep = torch.stack(timestep).to(self.device) model = self.preparemodelfortimestep(t, boundary, offloadmodel) sampleguidescale = guidescale[1] if t.item() >= boundary else guidescale[0] extrakwargs = {'tidx': stepidx} if hasattr(self, 'usesp') and self.usesp else {} if getclassifierfreeguidanceworldsize() == 2: noisepred = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argall, extrakwargs)[0].to( torch.device('cpu') if offloadmodel else self.device) noisepredcond, noisepreduncond = getcfggroup().allgather( noisepred, separatetensors=True ) if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() else: noisepredcond = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argc, extrakwargs)[0] if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() noisepreduncond = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argnull, extrakwargs)[0] if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() noisepred = noisepreduncond + sampleguidescale ( noisepredcond - noisepreduncond) 当检测到CFG并行环境时，它会将条件生成和无条件生成这两个任务分配到两个不同的进程上同时执行，每个进程只需要运行一次模型推理，然后通过allgather通信操作让两个进程互相获取对方的计算结果，最后使用CFG公式将条件预测和无条件预测按照引导系数混合，得到最终的噪声预测结果，如果没有启用并行环境则会退化到传统模式顺序执行两次模型推理。 Ring Attention Overlap 在多卡Ring Attention中，通过异步启动AllGather收集其他卡的KV数据，同时立即使用本地KV计算第一个FA，让NPU计算与网络通信并行执行以掩盖通信延迟；待AllGather完成后，将其他多个远程chunks合并为一个长序列一次性计算第二个FA，最后用LSE（Log-Sum-Exp）算法正确合并两次attention输出， 达成将通信时间隐藏在本地计算中 。 Dit-Cache DIT-Cache作为扩散模型推理加速的缓存框架，通过复用/预测已有的结果，减少冗余前向计算。其加速逻辑可清晰的分为Step-level和Block-level范式，Step-level通过判断不同采样步数step间的特定特征差异，通过阈值比较，决定是否跳过完整的step计算，直接复用或者预测缓存结果；Block-level以block为粒度（通常是attention模块和mlp模块）判断是否直接复用或者预测缓存结果。 本样例集成了Step-level的Dit-Cache方案，支持 FBCache 以及 TeaCache 。 Step-level典型方法： 在Step-level加速范畴内， FBCache 的原理是基于First Block L1误差，比较第一个Block输出残差与上一步的第一个Block输出残差之间的差异，如果首块输出误差与上一轮首块输出误差差异小于指定阈值，就跳过当前步计算，复用残差，对当前步的输出进行估计。 TeaCache 利用模型输入与输出的强相关性，通过Timestep Emebdding（输入）来估计输出差异：先利用该输入粗估输出变化，再通过多项式拟合修正缩放偏差，最终以累积差异作为判断标准，动态决定是否复用上一步被Cache的输出，避免冗余计算。由于WAN2.2具有CFG串行的特点，因此 cann-recipes-infer 采用teacache官方实现的cond/uncond分别管理的 TeaCache 。在cann-recipes-infer仓库见 cachemethod.py 。 启动方式： Dit-Cache 配置已收敛到启动 YAML 的 ditcache 段。单卡启用 Dit-Cache 时，将 infer.sh 中的 YAMLFILENAME 设置为 14bsingle.yaml ，然后通过 ditcache.method 选择 FBCache 或 TeaCache。当前 wan2.2-i2v 多卡路径与 Dit-Cache 不兼容，worldsize > 1 时框架会自动回退到 NoCache 并打印提示。 以 TeaCache 为例： yaml ditcache: method: "TeaCache" # NoCache / FBCache / TeaCache enableseparatecfg: true # CFG 分离开关，true 时 cond/uncond 各自维护缓存状态 params: # 仅填写需覆盖的参数；其余沿用 DEFAULTCACHECONFIG rell1thresh: 0.15 # 示例覆盖值；内置默认值 0.15，越大缓存复用越多、精度损失越大 coefficients: [733.226126, -401.131952, 67.5869174, -3.149879, 0.0961237896] warmup: 2 # 前 N 步与最后 N 步强制完整计算，不进行缓存判定 infer.sh 配置示例： bash export YAMLFILENAME=14bsingle.yaml mmfunction.sh 在拉起时会将该 YAML 作为 --cacheconfig 路径传给 generate.py，由 module/ditcache/cachemethod.py 的 loadcacheconfig() 解析 ditcache NPU npufusedinferattentionscore Operator Adaptation First, you need to import torchnpu and related packages, and add the following after generate.py (L30): import torchnpu torchnpu.npu.setcompilemode(jitcompile=False) torch.npu.config.allowinternalformat=False from torchnpu.contrib import transfertonpu This example uses the npufusedinferattentionscore fused operator built into torchnpu to replace the FlashAttention operator. Through (x-mean)/var1+0)(scale+1)+shift, the NPU fused operator npulayernormeval is invoked to fuse the 3 LNs with the corresponding modulate steps. 8-Card VAE Parallelism This example enables VAE parallelism for the model. Implemented through spatial parallelism, large-size images are split into multiple blocks along the height and width dimensions and assigned to different NPU processes for parallel processing, which can accelerate the VAE inference of the original model. This optimization is implemented in the vaepatchparallel.py script. The following VAE parallelism flow chart shows the complete execution path of spatial parallel processing: 1. First, the input tensor is split across multiple processes along the spatial dimension, and each process processes its own local blocks; 2. Then, during computation, corresponding communication strategies are adopted based on the characteristics of different operations — convolution operations obtain context by exchanging boundary data with neighbors, attention operations guarantee computational completeness by globally collecting all K and V tensors, and interpolation operations handle upsampling by expanding boundaries, computing, and then cropping; 3. Finally, through a two-stage collection process, the local results of each process are reassembled into a complete output tensor according to the original spatial positions. CFG Parallelism This example enables CFG parallelism for the model. It is implemented in image2video.py (L432): for stepidx, t in enumerate(tqdm(timesteps)): latentmodelinput = [latent.to(self.device)] timestep = [t] timestep = torch.stack(timestep).to(self.device) model = self.preparemodelfortimestep(t, boundary, offloadmodel) sampleguidescale = guidescale[1] if t.item() >= boundary else guidescale[0] extrakwargs = {'tidx': stepidx} if hasattr(self, 'usesp') and self.usesp else {} if getclassifierfreeguidanceworldsize() == 2: noisepred = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argall, extrakwargs)[0].to( torch.device('cpu') if offloadmodel else self.device) noisepredcond, noisepreduncond = getcfggroup().allgather( noisepred, separatetensors=True ) if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() else: noisepredcond = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argc, extrakwargs)[0] if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() noisepreduncond = model( latentmodelinput, t=timestep, argnull, extrakwargs)[0] if offloadmodel: torch.cuda.emptycache() noisepred = noisepreduncond + sampleguidescale ( noisepredcond - noisepreduncond) When a CFG parallel environment is detected, it assigns the two tasks of conditional generation and unconditional generation to two different processes for simultaneous execution. Each process only needs to run model inference once, then the allgather communication operation allows the two processes to obtain each other's computation results, and finally the CFG formula is used to mix the conditional and unconditional predictions according to the guidance scale to obtain the final noise prediction result. If the parallel environment is not enabled, it degrades to the traditional mode of executing model inference twice sequentially. Ring Attention Overlap In multi-card Ring Attention, AllGather is asynchronously started to collect the KV data from other cards, while the local KV is immediately used to compute the first FA, allowing NPU computation and network communication to execute in parallel to hide the communication latency. After AllGather completes, the other remote chunks are merged into a long sequence to compute the second FA at once. Finally, the LSE (Log-Sum-Exp) algorithm is used to correctly merge the two attention outputs, achieving the hiding of communication time in local computation . Dit-Cache DIT-Cache, as a cache framework for accelerating diffusion model inference, reduces redundant forward computation by reusing/predicting existing results. Its acceleration logic can be clearly divided into Step-level and Block-level paradigms. Step-level determines whether to skip the complete step computation by judging the specific feature differences between different sampling steps and comparing them against a threshold, directly reusing or predicting the cached results. Block-level judges whether to directly reuse or predict cached results at the granularity of blocks (usually attention modules and mlp modules). This example integrates the Step-level Dit-Cache scheme, supporting FBCache and TeaCache . Typical Step-level methods: Within the Step-level acceleration scope, the principle of FBCache is based on the First Block L1 error, comparing the difference between the output residual of the first block and the output residual of the first block in the previous step. If the difference between the first-block output error and the previous round's first-block output error is less than a specified threshold, the current step computation is skipped, the residual is reused, and the output of the current step is estimated. TeaCache leverages the strong correlation between model input and output, using the Timestep Embedding (input) to estimate output differences: first, the input is used to roughly estimate the output change, then polynomial fitting corrects the scaling bias, and finally the cumulative difference is used as the judgment criterion to dynamically decide whether to reuse the output cached in the previous step, avoiding redundant computation. Since WAN2.2 has the characteristic of serial CFG, cann-recipes-infer uses the officially implemented TeaCache that manages cond/uncond separately. See cachemethod.py in the cann-recipes-infer repository. How to enable: The Dit-Cache configuration has been consolidated into the ditcache section of the launch YAML. To enable Dit-Cache on a single card, set YAMLFILENAME in infer.sh to 14bsingle.yaml , then select FBCache or TeaCache via ditcache.method. Currently, the wan2.2-i2v multi-card path is incompatible with Dit-Cache; when worldsize > 1, the framework automatically falls back to NoCache and prints a prompt. Take TeaCache as an example: yaml ditcache: method: "TeaCache" # NoCache / FBCache / TeaCache enableseparatecfg: true # CFG separation switch; when true, cond/uncond each maintain their own cache state params: # Only fill in parameters that need to be overridden; the rest follow DEFAULTCACHECONFIG rell1thresh: 0.15 # Example override value; built-in default is 0.15. The larger the value, the more cache reuse and the greater the accuracy loss coefficients: [733.226126, -401.131952, 67.5869174, -3.149879, 0.0961237896] warmup: 2 # Force full computation for the first N steps and the last N steps without cache judgment Example infer.sh configuration: bash export YAMLFILENAME=14bsingle.yaml When mmfunction.sh starts up, it passes this YAML to generate.py as the --cacheconfig path. The loadcacheconfig() function in module/ditcache/cachemethod.py parses the ditcache section and merges the built-in default values. For the complete default values of each method, see module/ditcache/cachemethod.py:DEFAULTCACHECONFIG, and also refer to Multi-modal Inference Unified Launch Design (Chinese) §5. seqoffsetk=kvcachemetadata.totalhistoryoffsets, seqoffsett=jd.numcandidatesoffsets, pageoffsets=kvcachemetadata.kvindptr, pageids=kvcachemetadata.kvindices, lastpagelen=kvcachemetadata.kvlastpagelen, numtarget=jd.numcandidates, targetgroupsize=1) NPU npureshapeandcache算子 在kvcache管理方面，原始的kv cache的layout是[numpages, numlayers, 2, blocksize],我们将其修改为[numlayers 2, numpages, blocksize]形式，引入npureshapeandcache算子加速appendkvcache的计算。 python torchnpu.npureshapeandcache(srck, srcv, pagedkcache, pagedvcache, sloti32) NPU concatndjagged算子 我们将 GPU 侧的 Triton 融合算子 tritonconcat2Djagged 以及 CUDA 融合算子 jagged2Dtensorconcat 统一替换为 NPU 侧的 concatndjagged，实现同等功能的高效迁移。concatndjagged算子在 RecSDK 团队开发的concat2djagged算子基础上优化衍生，原生算子仅支持 2 个 tensor 的 concat，不能完全满足HSTU模型的场景要求；我们在 Torch 适配层完成增强改造，将能力扩展为支持 n（n≥2） 个 tensor 的 jagged concat 场景，从而覆盖更通用的融合拼接需求并降低算子分裂与维护成本。 分布式推理 我们在推理侧新增了分布式推理能力，主要是Embedding Tensor Parallel (TP) 和 Data Parallel (DP) 。生成式推荐与普通LLM任务的最大不同在于：LLM参数主要集中在dense Transformer权重里，输入token来自于相对固定的文本词表；而生成式推荐往往把用户、物品、上下文等离散特征统一建模为token，其模型容量绝大部分来自超大规模的稀疏参数（Embedding Tables），词表规模可达千万甚至上亿。基于此，我们在推理侧引入Embedding TP（如下图），对大表按vocab维度切分到不同NPU上，以减少单卡显存负担，支撑模型推理。同时，在Embedding TP外采用DP进行并行处理，Embedding部分进行DP -> TP -> DP的操作。 KV Offload并行 在执行调度上，我们进一步引入 KV Offload 与 HSTU dense 计算并行（如下图）：原仓实现需要等待 HSTU dense 完成后，再逐层执行 KV offload，这样的计算与KV Offload串行的方式并行度不高，导致性能较差；而在 NPU 上，我们将 offload 时机前移到每层 Attention 结束后立即触发该层 KV offload，并放到另一条 NPU stream 异步执行，从而实现计算链路（HSTU dense + MLP + 后处理）与通信链路（KV offload）的重叠，显著降低流水线空泡并大幅提升整体性能。 其他优化方向 后续将继续尝试优化hstu前后处理的逻辑，使用融合算子对前处理部分的concat2djagged进行处理；使能hstu dense模块计算与offload并行；以及完成更多融合算子的开发和接入，以进一步降低推理时延，提升性能。此外，在embedding处理和offload流程上我们也将通过尝试使能shmen等手段进一步提升性能。

HSTU Model Inference Optimization on NPU This document mainly introduces the NPU-based inference optimization strategies for the HSTU model. NPU Model Adaptation Based on the Nvidia Recsys-Examples repository, we implemented Torch small-operator replacements for GPU operators and KV Cache management logic, and implemented the NPU kvcachemanagerimpl class to replace the original tensorrt-llm framework implementation logic. We implemented the allocatepools, getprimarypool, getnumfreeblocks, addsequencewitheviction, removesequence, evictallsequences, getcachedstartposition, getnumtokenscached, and getcacheblockids methods of kvcachemanagerimpl. The implementation code is in the kvcachemanagerimpl.py file. For the small-operator adaptation logic, we adapted the jagged2Dtensorconcat, torchsplit2Djagged, torchaddpositionembeddings, torchaddtimestamppositionalembeddings, and other torch operator implementations. In addition, for the GPU-related dynamic embedding, we implement it using nn.Embedding. NPU Operator Adaptation NPU hstu Fused Operator In the hstu attention part, Nvidia implements its own CUDA operator. A corresponding fused operator already exists on NPU. Based on the computation logic, we implemented the hstupaged fused operator adaptation. python jaggedattnoutput = torch.ops.mxrec.hstupaged(q=query, k=key, v=value, kvcache=kvcachetable, mask=None, attnbias=None, masktype=2, maxseqlen=self.maxseqlen, maxseqlenk=jd.seqlenk, siluscale=1.0 / self.maxseqlen, seqoffset=jd.seqlenoffsets, seqoffsetk=kvcachemetadata.totalhistoryoffsets, seqoffsett=jd.numcandidatesoffsets, pageoffsets=kvcachemetadata.kvindptr, pageids=kvcachemetadata.kvindices, lastpagelen=kvcachemetadata.kvlastpagelen, numtarget=jd.numcandidates, targetgroupsize=1) NPU npureshapeandcache Operator For kvcache management, the original kv cache layout is [numpages, numlayers, 2, blocksize]. We modified it to the [numlayers 2, numpages, blocksize] form and introduced the npureshapeandcache operator to accelerate the appendkvcache computation. python torchnpu.npureshapeandcache(srck, srcv, pagedkcache, pagedvcache, sloti32) NPU concatndjagged Operator We uniformly replaced the GPU-side Triton fused operator tritonconcat2Djagged and the CUDA fused operator jagged2Dtensorconcat with the NPU-side concatndjagged, achieving an efficient migration with equivalent functionality. The concatndjagged operator is derived and optimized from the concat2djagged operator developed by the RecSDK team. The native operator only supports concatenating 2 tensors and cannot fully meet the scenario requirements of the HSTU model; we completed the enhancement at the Torch adaptation layer, extending the capability to support jagged concat scenarios of n (n≥2) tensors, thereby covering more general fused concatenation requirements and reducing operator fragmentation and maintenance costs. Distributed Inference We added distributed inference capability on the inference side, mainly Embedding Tensor Parallel (TP) and Data Parallel (DP). The biggest difference between generative recommendation and ordinary LLM tasks is that LLM parameters are mainly concentrated in the dense Transformer weights, and input tokens come from a relatively fixed text vocabulary; whereas generative recommendation often models discrete features such as users, items, and context uniformly as tokens, and most of its model capacity comes from ultra-large-scale sparse parameters (Embedding Tables), with the vocabulary scale reaching tens of millions or even hundreds of millions. Based on this, we introduced Embedding TP on the inference side (as shown below), sharding the large tables by vocab dimension onto different NPUs, so as to reduce the single-card memory burden and support model inference. At the same time, DP is adopted outside Embedding TP for parallel processing, and the Embedding part performs the DP -> TP -> DP operation. KV Offload Parallelism In terms of execution scheduling, we further introduced KV Offload in parallel with HSTU dense computation (as shown below): the original repository implementation needs to wait for HSTU dense to complete before executing KV offload layer by layer. Such a serial manner of computation and KV Offload has low parallelism, resulting in poor performance; on NPU, we moved the offload timing forward to immediately trigger the KV offload of that layer right after each layer's Attention completes, and put it on another NPU stream for asynchronous execution, thereby overlapping the computation pipeline (HSTU dense + MLP + post-processing) with the communication pipeline (KV offload), significantly reducing pipeline bubbles and greatly improving overall performance. Other Optimization Directions In the future, we will continue to try to optimize the hstu pre-processing and post-processing logic, using fused operators to handle the concat2djagged in the pre-processing part; enable the hstu dense module computation to run in parallel with offload; and complete the development and integration of more fused operators, so as to further reduce inference latency and improve performance. In addition, in the embedding processing and offload flows, we will also try to enable shmen and other means to further improve performance.

History Tree Dynamic RL 投机解码 1. 简介 Dynamic RL 是面向 RL Rollout 长序列采样的投机解码策略。它把同一套 Rollout 请求在解码过程中的历史响应复用能力和 EAGLE3 草稿模型能力组合起来，在不同 batch size 和不同阶段下动态选择更合适的草稿来源： historytree：从上一轮 Rollout 产生的响应中提取高 reward 片段，构建固定长度历史草稿缓存，在后续相同 prompt 或相似上下文中直接给出草稿 token。 eagle3：使用独立 EAGLE3 draft model 生成草稿 token，适合较小 batch size 下的长尾解码阶段。 dynamicrl：同时接入 historytree 与 eagle3，按 batch size、历史缓存预热状态和在线 timing 统计动态切换。 本文档覆盖当前 patch 已实现的 Dynamic RL 相关能力。 2. 使用说明 2.1 最小启动配置 在 veRL 启动脚本中配置 Rollout 投机方法为 dynamicrl，并指定 EAGLE3 draft model： bash actorrolloutref.rollout.specmethod='dynamicrl' actorrolloutref.rollout.eagle3draftmodel='/path/to/Qwen3-30B-moe-eagle3' actorrolloutref.rollout.specnumspeculativetokens=4 当前 EAGLE3 分支使用 chain draft，只需要配置 draft model 路径和草稿 token 数。 如果只验证历史响应复用分支，可将 specmethod 设置为 historytree，此时不需要 eagle3draftmodel： bash actorrolloutref.rollout.specmethod='historytree' actorrolloutref.rollout.specnumspeculativetokens=4 仓库内提供了 Qwen3-30B 16 卡 GRPO 最小复现脚本： bash cd 20 前 N 步强制采集 timing。 3. 实现方案 3.1 veRL 接入 veRL 侧新增 Rollout 配置 specmethod、eagle3draftmodel、specnumspeculativetokens。当 specmethod 为 historytree 或 dynamicrl 时，训练主流程在每轮 Rollout 前后传递历史记录，并由各 Rollout worker 更新本地 history cache。 Rollout 结束后，trainer 会从 batch 中提取： prompt token ids，用于生成稳定的 promptid； response token ids，用于构造历史草稿； token-level reward，用于在同一 prefix 下选择更优候选。 这些记录通过 historytreerecords 传入 vLLM Rollout worker，并同步到 proposer 的 history cache。 相关代码： 0020-verl-feature-enablehistorytreedynamicrl.patch 3.2 vLLM 配置与 EAGLE3 适配 vLLM 侧将 historytree 和 dynamicrl 注册为 speculative method，并复用 EAGLE3 的 draft model 配置路径。dynamicrl 在 EAGLE 分支中会被标准化为 EAGLE3 chain draft 行为，确保 auxiliary hidden states 与 EAGLE3 draft head 正确启用。 相关代码： 0004-vllm-feature-enablehistorytreedynamicrl.patch 3.3 vLLM-Ascend proposer vLLM-Ascend 侧新增两个 proposer： HistoryRolloutProposer：维护按 prompt 隔离的 FixedDraftHistoryCache，同时保留全局 fallback cache。它从历史响应中按固定 prefix 长度提取候选草稿，并按 reward 优先更新。 DynamicProposer：内部持有 HistoryRolloutProposer 与 EagleProposer，在每个 decode step 基于 batch bucket、预热状态和 timing 统计选择当前分支。 dynamicrl 默认策略 timingguard 的核心逻辑： 1. 大 batch 直接使用 history rollout，避免 EAGLE3 在高 batch 下引入额外开销。 2. history cache 未预热时，优先收集历史分支 timing。 3. 小 batch 进入长尾阶段后，按 bucket 记录 history 和 EAGLE3 的 tokens/ms EMA。 4. 只有当 EAGLE3 评分超过 history 评分并满足 VLLMDYNAMICRLSWITCHMARGIN 时才切换。 5. 如果 EAGLE3 探测效果差，则回退 history 并进入 cooldown。 相关代码： Length-Aware Resampler：基于历史 Response 长度的 Rollout 重采样优化 1. 简介 RL On-Policy 训练的 Rollout 阶段通常会遇到明显的 response 长尾问题：不同 prompt 的生成长度差异很大，而单个 generation batch 内往往会同时混入极长和极短样本。这样会带来两个直接问题： 1. 同一批次中，短样本很快结束，长样本持续占用推理资源，导致整体吞吐被少量长尾样本拖慢。 2. 某些 batch 的生成长度远高于平均值，容易放大 step 时间抖动，影响训练吞吐稳定性。 为缓解这一问题，本优化在 verl 的 RL 数据采样路径中新增了 LengthAwareEpochSampler。该 sampler 会利用上一轮 rollout 收集到的 response 长度统计，在下一轮 epoch 开始时对样本顺序进行重排，把预估长度接近的 prompt 尽量放到邻近 batch 中。 2. 使用说明 2.1 Patch 位置 本特性以 Git Patch 的形式交付，文件位于： text llmrl/qwen3/verl-mindspeed/patches/verl/0019-verl-feature-lengthawareresampler.patch 在 llmrl/qwen3/verl-mindspeed/ 目录下执行以下命令即可应用全部 patch： bash bash applyallpatches.sh 2.2 Hydra 配置 应用 patch 后，可通过以下配置启用 Length-Aware Resampler： bash data.sampler.classpath=pkg://verl.experimental.dataset.lengthbucketsampler data.sampler.classname=LengthAwareEpochSampler data.sampler.bucketsize=1024 data.sampler.emadecay=0.7 data.sampler.shufflebatchblocks=True data.dataloadernumworkers=0 data.shuffle=False 建议保持训练 dataloader 的 droplast=True。当前 qwen3 样例中的训练 dataloader 默认就是按该方式构建。 2.3 可选长尾保护 在某些任务中，即使做了长度重排，仍然可能存在极个别 batch 的 response 长度远超平均值。为此本特性提供了一个可选的 maxtokens 动态裁剪能力： bash export VLLMROLLOUTEARLYSTOPENABLE=1 export VLLMROLLOUTEARLYSTOPFACTOR=2.0 export VLLMROLLOUTEARLYSTOPMINTOKENS=10000 其裁剪逻辑为： text cap = min(responselength, max(mintokens, factor expectedlen)) 其中 expectedlen 为当前 batch 样本在历史统计中的平均 response 长度估计值。 2.4 最小可复现脚本 本样例提供了一个最小可复现脚本： text llmrl/qwen3/verl-mindspeed/internal/traingrpoqwen3resamplerexample.sh 该脚本保留了以下内容： 1. 16 卡 GRPO 的基本训练参数 2. 使用前请按实际环境设置以下占位变量： bash export MODELPATH=/path/to/model export DISTCPPATH=/path/to/distcheckpoint export TRAINFILE=/path/to/train.parquet export TESTFILE=/path/to/test.parquet 如果奖励函数路径不在默认位置，也可以额外指定： bash export REWARDFUNCTIONPATH=/path/to/rewardfunction.py 在 llmrl/qwen3/verl-mindspeed/ 目录下执行： bash bash internal/traingrpoqwen3resamplerexample.sh 脚本默认启用以下行为： 1. 开启 LengthAwareEpochSampler 2. 开启 rollout 长尾保护 3. 保持 data.dataloadernumworkers=0 4. 默认不保存 checkpoint；如需保存，可设置 SAVECKPTENABLE=1 如果需要切回 eager baseline 且关闭 resampler，可设置： bash export VLLMEAGERBASELINENORESAMPLE=1 3. 实现方案 3.1 基于历史 rollout 统计的长度估计 新增 LengthAwareEpochSampler，继承 AbstractCurriculumSampler。核心做法如下： 1. 每个样本维护一个 response 长度估计值。 2. 在训练 step 完成后，通过 responsemask.sum(-1) 统计真实 response 长度。 3. 将统计结果按样本 id 聚合，并使用 EMA 更新样本的长度估计。 4. 在下一轮 epoch 开始时，依据估计长度排序，并按 batch block 做可选打散。 这样做的目标不是精确预测每条样本的输出长度，而是在 batch 级别减少长短样本混排。 3.2 稳定样本 id 回写 为了把 rollout 统计稳定回写到 dataset 样本，本优化为 RLHFDataset.getitem 返回的样本新增 datasetitemidx 字段。该字段使用 dataset 内部的样本索引，保证不同 epoch 间可以回到同一条原始样本。 3.3 训练集按完整 batch 对齐 本优化会将训练集样本数向下截断到 genbatchsize 的整数倍。这样在 droplast=True 的前提下，每个 epoch 看到的是固定 prompt 集合，避免尾部零散样本在 epoch 切换时扰乱长度统计。 3.4 Rollout 阶段动态下发 response cap 当 dataloader sampler 为 AbstractCurriculumSampler 时，trainer 会在生成前读取当前 batch 的历史长度估计，并据此计算一个可选的 responsemaxtokenscap。随后在 vLLM rollout 侧通过覆写 SamplingParams.maxtokens 的方式，把该 cap 下发给本批次生成请求。 这样做有两个特点： 1. 不修改全局 rollout responselength 配置，只对当前 batch 生效。 2. 如果计算得到的 cap 不小于原始 responselength，则保持原行为不变。 4. 收益与适用场景 本优化更适用于以下场景： 1. prompt 长度相近，但 response 长度差异很大的 RL 数据集。 2. rollout 阶段存在明显长尾 batch，导致 step 时间抖动较大。 3. 关注 generation 吞吐稳定性，希望减少“极长样本拖慢整批”的现象。 在这类场景下，Length-Aware Resampler 通常能带来以下收益： 1. 降低 generation batch 内部的长短样本混排程度。 2. 减少极端长尾 batch 的出现频率。 3. 提升 rollout 吞吐稳定性，并改善 step 时间分布。 由于收益与数据分布、n、genbatchsize、responselength 等配置强相关，建议结合以下指标做实际观测： 目前在n=16, genbatchsize=32, responselength=16384场景下，qwen30b-a3b-moe模型的rollouts阶段的吞吐量能够提升约20%。 1. timings/generatesequences 2. perf/throughput 或 rollout 吞吐相关指标 3. rollout/responsemaxtokenscap 5. 注意事项 1. 使用 curriculum sampler 时，建议设置 data.dataloadernumworkers=0，避免 dataloader worker 持有过期 sampler 状态。 2. 如果你的数据集 response 长度分布本身较为集中，该特性的收益可能有限。 3. responsemaxtokenscap 是一个保守的长尾保护机制。若任务对完整长响应有强依赖，应谨慎设置 factor 和 mintokens。

RL On-Policy 推理场景的序列级均衡调度引擎 1. 简介 RLHF的Rollout阶段面临典型的“木桶效应”：由于输入Prompt所生成的响应（Response）长度存在长尾分布，少数极长的生成任务会拖慢整个DP组的进展。这使得处理短序列的节点在完成计算后不得不进入长时间的闲置等待，造成算力浪费。长尾问题优化的本质是RL训练系统的负载均衡，对此，我们针对单轮推理的同步场景，优化目标是提升进入长尾状态后的推理效率。 2. 使用说明 2.1 初始化配置 在verl/workers/megatronworkers.py文件开头追加了以下代码，通过环境变量ROLLOUTREBALANCEENABLE=1使能本特性功能： python from patches.verl.features.rolloutoptimize import initrolloutrebalance initrolloutrebalance() 2.2 配置项介绍 可以直接在config.py中修改配置，或将以下配置写入verl启动的yaml中，在2.1节所写位置进行配置提取并传入initrolloutrebalance方法。 python class RolloutRebalanceConfig: enable = int(os.environ.get("ROLLOUTREBALANCEENABLE", "0")) # RolloutRebalance特性总开关 checkinterval = 1000 # 间隔多少个step进行一次rebalance检查 multigraph = True # 是否开启多档位编图，如果关闭，rebalance依然会按预编图的档位做均衡调度，但是不会形成明显的性能收益 graphbatchsizes = [64, 32, 16, 8, 4] # 预编图的档位设置 profile = True # 是否打印过程中的性能数据 profileinterval = 100 # 打印间隔步长 3. 实现方案 本优化的核心目标是在On Policy场景中，针对部分Rollout提前结束导致各rank间的负载不均时，对未结束的Rollout进行负载均衡的策略分析和重调度，从而提升计算资源的利用率和长尾状态下的推理效率。 前置依赖： vllmascend上在torchairgraphconfig中提供了usecachedgraph和graphbatchsizes的能力，支持提前配置多档位BatchSize的图，并随着剩余Seq减少时自动匹配最小BatchSize的图进行推理。 本方案中包含以下关键功能实现： 1. Rebalance条件检测与调度策略生成； 2. Request(SEQ)级的数据搬迁与恢复（包含对应的kvCache）； 3. Rollout后的结果还原； 3.1 具体实现 以下的详细代码均位于rolloutrebalance.py文件中： 全局状态感知 python def getcurrentstate(self): return dict( rank=self.rank, reqids=list(self.llmengine.outputprocessor.requeststates.keys()), ) Python def syncgroupstates(self): if self.worldsize == 1: return [self.getcurrentstate()] groupstates = [None for in range(self.worldsize)] dist.allgatherobject(groupstates, self.getcurrentstate(), group=self.dpgroup) return groupstates 基于BatchSize档位预设的最大档位最小化均衡算法 python def calcbalancingtasks(self, rankstatelist): """ 计算最优的请求迁移任务清单，以实现负载均衡。 最优策略定义为三层目标： 1. 主要目标：将整个DP组所需的最大档位(maxbs)降至最低。 2. 次要目标：在满足1的前提下，使迁移的请求数量(cost)最少。 3. 补充目标：在满足1和2的前提下，使得各个rank间的数据搬迁流向尽可能均匀，避免多对一阻塞。 """ balancingtasks = [] rankcntlist = [x['running'] + x['waiting'] for x in rankstatelist] maxbsbefore = max(self.getbs(x) for x in rankcntlist) avgbs = sum(rankcntlist) / len(rankcntlist) maxbsnext = min(maxbsbefore, States.graphbatchsizes[0], self.scheduler.maxnumrunningreqs) for targetbs in States.graphbatchsizes[::-1]: if avgbs 0.8: continue delta = maxbsnext - rankstate['running'] if delta > 0: if usage > 0: capacity = min(delta, int(rankstate['running'] (1 - usage) / usage)) else: capacity = delta receivers.append(dict( rank=rankstate['rank'], capacity=capacity, running=rankstate['running'], )) elif delta 0 and currentdonoridx 0: balancingtasks.append(dict( fromrank=donor['rank'], torank=receiver['rank'], numtomove=numcanmove, needkvcache=False, )) numtoassign -= numcanmove donor['waiting'] -= numcanmove receiver['capacity'] -= numcanmove if donor['waiting'] == 0: currentdonoridx += 1 waitingdonors = [x for x in waitingdonors if x['waiting']] if waitingdonors: return balancingtasks if maxbsnext >= maxbsbefore: return balancingtasks while otherdonors and receivers: donorindex = 0 for receiver in sorted(receivers, key=lambda r: r['capacity'], reverse=True): donor = otherdonors[donorindex] numtomove = min(donor['surplus'], receiver['capacity']) if numtomove > 0: balancingtasks.append(dict( fromrank=donor['rank'], torank=receiver['rank'], numtomove=numtomove, needkvcache=True, )) donor['surplus'] -= numtomove receiver['capacity'] -= numtomove donorindex = (donorindex + 1) % len(otherdonors) otherdonors = [x for x in otherdonors if x['surplus']] receivers = [x for x in receivers if x['capacity']] return data.maxresponselength=32768; actorrolloutref.rollout.n=16; TP=4; DP=32; 性能收益主要来自于单个step的TPOT性能的差距，默认场景下的TPOT会从125ms上升到200ms，而通过使能Rebalance并配合多档位编图，能在12K推理长度时就快速将推理档位降低，让单个step的TPOT降低到60ms的量级，在长尾场景下，性能差距被持续放大。

基于 SAM（后缀自动机） 的无损投机推理技术 1. 简介 在大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习后训练过程中，为了收集高质量的训练数据或评估模型策略性能，需要在训练过程中进行海量的交互式采样（Rollout）。这个采样过程占据了整个训练链条绝大部分的时间和计算开销，因此，如何高效执行采样已成为提升后训练效率的关键瓶颈。 投机解码（Speculative Decoding）技术是一种常见的推理加速方案。然而，当前主流的基于模型（Model-Based）的投机解码方法，如 EAGLE 或 MTP，需要依赖一个额外训练的小型辅助草稿模型（Draft Model）。在模型参数频繁更新的后训练场景中，保持草稿模型与主模型同步需要引入显著的额外训练和部署成本，严重限制了其应用效率。 对此，我们尝试引入一种无模型（Model-Free），基于 SAM（后缀自动机）的无损投机解码方案，旨在不引入额外模型参数的前提下加速 RL 采样过程。 对于 SAM 技术的详细介绍请参见文章： SAM 投机推理：长序列强化学习训练加速利器 。 2. 使用说明 为了开启投机推理，需要配置以下变量。 配置 类型 说明 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------- ------------------------------------------------- actorrolloutref.rollout.enginekwargs.vllm.speculativeconfig.method veRL Hydra 命令行参数 投机推理的方法，例如 SAM，必须配置。 actorrolloutref.rollout.enginekwargs.vllm.speculativeconfig.numspeculativetokens veRL Hydra 命令行参数 投机推理的预测 token 数，必须配置。 VLLMSPECULATIVEBATCHSIZETHRE 环境变量 batchsize 自适应开关阈值，可选配置，默认值为 32。 例如，Qwen3-32B 样例默认配置了 method=sam 和 numspeculativetokens=3，开启 SAM 无损投机推理特性；如果希望关闭 SAM 无损投机推理特性，需要在启动 verl 训练任务时移除 internal/traingrpoqwen332b32dietrueweight.sh 中的这 2 个 Hydra 配置。示例如下： diff ... python3 -m verl.trainer.mainppo --config-path="${CONFIGDIR}" \ -config-name='ppomegatrontrainer.yaml' \ ... actorrolloutref.actor.megatron.overridetransformerconfig.cpwindowsize=1 \ +actorrolloutref.rollout.enginekwargs.vllm.speculativeconfig.method=sam \ +actorrolloutref.rollout.enginekwargs.vllm.speculativeconfig.numspeculativetokens=3 \ $@ 3. 实现方案 本方案基于 vLLM 和 vLLM-Ascend 框架实现了基于 SAM 的投机推理。通过动态后缀自动机（D-SAM），系统能够在无需额外辅助模型训练开销的情况下，在线、增量、高效地编码当前序列的所有子串信息，在 $O(1)$ 的平均时间内从现有 Rollout 序列中检索出候选草稿，从而能够显著降低 Rollout 采样过程中的推理时延。相比传统检索模型如 N-gram，SAM 能够具有更高的运行效率和接受率。 同时，为了达成更好的加速效果，我们还进行了其他优化： 拒绝采样加速：通过重写 vllmascend 中的rejectionsampler代码，优化了投机推理的整体表现。 batchsize 自适应开关：针对在 Rollout 的初始阶段，batchsize 巨大导致投机推理产生严重性能劣化的问题，检测 batchsize 超出阈值时关闭投机推理。在规避高 batchsize 下投机推理性能劣化的同时，为 SAM 自动机提供预热阶段。当 Rollout 进入长尾阶段，batchsize 数减少时，动态开启投机推理，从而达成更优的加速效果。 对于这些解决方案的详细介绍请参见文章： SAM 投机推理：长序列强化学习训练加速利器 。 具体实现 SAM 类 SAM 无损投机推理能力的核心组件，实现了上文提到的动态 SAM 自动机本体，提供以下能力接口： 1. 状态更新 addtokens(tokens)：将新的token添加到自动机中，同时扩展自动机的状态。 2. 序列预测 gendraft(index, starttoken): 从当前输入的token生成指定数量个 token 的后续序列。 代码： vllmascend/specdecode/samproposer.py SAMProposer 类 vllm-ascend后端调用SAM能力的适配接口。vllmascend通过NPUModelRunner中的proposedrafttokenids调用此接口。 SAMProposer会调用SAM提供的状态更新与序列预测能力。 代码： vllmascend/specdecode/samproposer.py 拒绝采样加速 用高效 tensor 操作替换了vLLMAscend的AscendRejectionSampler实现中的多个 for 循环，提升投机推理的整体效率。 代码： vllmascend/0008-vllmascend-feature-treerejectionsampler.patch batchsize 自适应开关 在vllmascend的NPUModelRunner添加一个动态开关。每当NPUModelRunner取得输入请求，它会检测 batchsize 是否超过阈值，并通过 flag speculativedecodingactive来控制投机推理的开启与关闭。 代码： 0001-vllmascend-feature-bsthresholdforspecdecode.patch 4. 使能效果 我们在 Qwen3-32B Dense 模型上，于真实的 RL 后训练场景（DAPO，数学推理数据集上）进行了全面的端到端验证。 相关配置： 数据集： DAPO\-MATH\-17k 最大输出长度（maxresponselength）：34816 训练 batch 大小（trainbatchsize）：32 生成 batch 大小（genbatchsize）：96 Rollout 最大请求数（maxnumseqs）：128 Rollout 模型张量并行（tensormodelparallelsize）：8 SAM 相关配置：自适应 batch size 开关阈值为 8，投机 token 个数为 3。 910C 卡数：2 机 16 卡 32die 运行模式：eager 1. 精度验证： 基于 Qwen3\-32B 模型在数学数据集 GSM8k 以及 AIME2024 基于昇腾950超节点的万亿MoE模型预训练系统参考实践 摘要：本文针对昇腾 950 超节点架构，基于 PyTorch 原生训练框架 + TorchTitan-NPU 昇腾插件，提出了一套面向万亿 MoE 模型的高效预训练部署与优化的系统方案。为应对超大规模、超长序列、多模态、高可用训练及训练开发者效率提升等复杂场景的挑战，本实践系统性构建了涵盖并行策略、内存优化、长序列优化、通算掩盖、DSL算子接入、算子自动融合、分布式优化器、图编译优化及训练高可用等全栈关键技术，并在 DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 系列模型上完成了端到端的全流程验证。 本文涉及的所有代码已开源：https://gitcode.com/cann/torchtitan-npu Highlights 极致性能与显存优化：系统构建了参数与优化器状态卸载、细粒度激活值重计算与 Swap、Profile-aware 图编译通算掩盖、Cube-Vector (CV) 流水重叠以及自研 FlexMuon 分布式优化器等技术。在昇腾 950 Ascend C 算子自动融合 返回总览 Highlights 端到端 Vector 算子自动融合：依托 Inductor + Ascend C AutoFuse ，复用 torch.compile 编译入口自动生成面向昇腾 NPU 的 Ascend C 融合算子，消除中间张量换入换出开销，实现“零开发成本、高执行性能”。 模型吞吐提升：在本文 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 训练中，使能 AutoFuse 后整网开箱加速比超19%，收益主要来自 AIV 算子融合及 Host Bound 缓解带来的 Free Time 减少。 1. torch.compile inductor + AutoFuse 简介 随着 MoE 与多模态架构的普及，动态、细粒度的小算子组合已成为主流设计模式。以 DeepSeek 提出的 mHC 为例，其将 HC 过程分解为 HcRes、HcPre 与 HcPost 三部分，分别通过双随机矩阵与 Sigmoid 门控系数保障数学性质，但实现上依赖大量细碎的 PyTorch 操作。这类灵活结构在模型设计中日益普遍，若延续传统手写融合算子的方式，开发效率已难以匹配模型迭代速度，算子自动化融合能力由此成为刚需。 torch.compile 为此提供了基础能力：通过捕获 FX 计算图将模型逻辑转换为算子图表示，交由 Inductor 后端进行算子融合与代码生成。Inductor 通过垂直与水平融合策略，将多个细碎操作合并为单一高效内核，实现跨算子的全局优化。TorchTitan 对 torch.compile 提供了原生深度支持，可充分复用 PyTorch 现有的编译生态基础设施与优化成果。 然而，NPU 与 GPU 在内存架构与计算范式上存在本质差异，直接沿用 GPU 优化策略难以充分释放 NPU 潜力。为此，CANN 框架的 AutoFuse 组件在继承 Inductor 整体流程的基础上，实现了目标为 Ascend C 的 Schedule & Codegen 后端。通过架构感知的融合策略与指令调度，实现从计算图到高效 NPU 算子代码的自动化映射，显著提升融合算子在昇腾平台上的执行效率。 autofuse backend 在本实践的训练场景中，由于不开启 TP 切分使得各算子的计算量本身较大，做算子融合后 Kernel Launch 开销占比极低，不存在静态图的收益空间。因而我们采用动态图 Eager 模式执行编译后的算子图，且 Eager 模式无需处理动态 Shape 约束，更为简洁灵活，已可获取融合的主要性能收益。 2. AutoFuse 亮点 使用简单：PyTorch 前端增加一行代码即可使能 性能提升：依赖 NPU 亲和的算子生成技术，本次模型融合收益约 19% 亲和 NPU，模板规约的 Schedule 技术 基于硬件建模，动态求解的算子 Tiling 技术 基于 Ascend LoopIR 表达的，Ascend C 算子 kernel 代码生成技术 泛化与完备度：当前已支持 152 个 LoopIR 表达中的 140 个，未来将逐步补齐，与 LoopIR 完整对等 3. PyTorch 原生训练框架下的 950 超节点部署策略 返回总览 Highlights 昇腾 950 超节点以 128 卡高带宽 ScaleUp 域为核心，将 MoE 高频专家通信收敛在超节点内，并通过跨超节点 FSDP、分层内存与按需 PP，实现从 550B、1.6T 向 10T 级模型的平滑扩展。 基于 torchtitan-npu 的 PC16 集群已完成 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 端到端持续预训练验证，64 卡 4K 吞吐达到 2131 tokens/s/卡，验证了超节点架构在大规模 MoE 训练中的工程可行性。 1. 从参数扩展到系统扩展： 大模型沿着 Scaling Law 持续演进，MoE 通过稀疏激活，为模型容量与计算开销之间提供了更灵活的选择：增加专家可以扩大总参数容量，而每个 token 只调用其中一部分专家，让单 token 计算量更多地取决于激活参数。能否把这种扩展潜力转化为训练效率，关键在于底层系统能否同时接住更大的模型状态与高频的专家通信。 这两类压力有着不同的增长方式。权重、梯度和优化器状态的总容量通常随参数规模增长；专家路由中的 AllToAll 则主要搬运激活，其逻辑数据量取决于 token 数、隐藏维度、top-k 和通信精度。在这些条件保持一致时，增加专家数量并不必然带来同比例的路由流量增长。但如果通信跨越更多节点，或路由负载失衡，即使数据量相近，实际耗时也可能增加。MoE 扩展的系统要点，是让专家容量可以增长，同时把高频路由通信保持在高带宽域内。 1.1 昇腾 950 超节点亲和超大规模 MoE 950 超节点的架构：具体结构可参考 昇腾 950 NPU 架构白皮书 和 灵衢超节点参考架构白皮书 。 128 × Ascend 950DT = 8 × PC16 服务器，采用了128 卡全互联架构； 每卡 UB 3.2Tbps（8×400G），scaleup 域有效带宽 400GB/s/卡；scaleout 50GB/s/卡——8× 带宽分层 超节点内存池：18TB HBM（144GB × 128，组网物理口径）+ 12TB DDR（8 × 1536GB） supernode architecture 通信策略： ScaleUp 域，灵衢总线提供每卡 400GB/s 的域内带宽，ScaleOut 侧为每卡 50GB/s。面对这一带宽层次，模型的切分策略也应有所侧重：将 EP 专家并行优先部署在超节点内部，使 token 的分发与汇聚充分使用域内互联；当模型状态超过单超节点预算时，再向超节点之间扩展权重分片，并通过预取与计算重叠降低通信暴露。核心目标是尽量把通信收敛在 scaleup 域内以提升 MFU 内存策略： UBL128 按物理规格约有 18TB HBM 与 12TB Host DDR。HBM 优先保障计算权重、激活和通信工作区，适合卸载的优化器状态及 Engram 表可按需放入 DDR。分层存储扩大了可部署空间，也引入了数据访问和搬运开销，因此必须连同带宽与重叠窗口一起设计。 由此，超节点成为超大规模 MoE 的扩展单元：域内承接频繁的专家交互，域间承担容量扩展和副本协同。模型从千亿走向万亿、十万亿参数时，可以沿着相同的通信局部性原则逐步扩展。 1.2 PC16：高密度、易扩展的超节点计算单元 PC16（Atlas 850e 16P）每台集成 16 张 NPU，8 台即可组成一个 128 卡全互联超节点。服务器数量和组网方式固定，部署时可以按这套配置安排设备、布线和维护；扩容时复用相同的超节点配置即可。 对 MoE 大模型训练，PC16 组成的超节点可以将专家分发与集合通信放在高速 UB 网络内。服务器上的大容量 Host DDR 可用于卸载优化器状态和 Engram 表，减轻 HBM 的存储压力。模型需要更多资源时，再通过 UBG 连接多个超节点，扩展权重分片范围。 -- 2. 从550B、1.6T 到 10T：昇腾 950 超节点上的大规模 MoE 切分策略 不同规模的模型，需要在模型状态、长序列激活、集合通信和流水气泡之间寻找合适的平衡。550B 档优先发挥单超节点的通信优势，1.6T 档通过流水并行分摊层与激活，而面向 10T 的外推，则采用“超内大 EP、超间扩 FSDP、按需加 PP”的分层路线。 本文中，550B对应DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，另有约 196.6B Engram 参数，合计约 749B；1.6T则对应 DeepSeek V4 Pro；10T 为规模外推，不对应已验证模型。三档的策略与权衡如下。 对比维度 550B：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1.6T：DeepSeek V4 Pro 10T：规模外推 -------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
